programme.title: Mama Ghost
programme.desc: 在一个沿海小镇,Rico与Sisca发展了一段不可能的恋情,却因他们相爱而引发恶灵的出现。随著整个城镇发生连串骇人听闻的死亡事件,也揭露了隐藏多年的秘密,使到整个城镇被一股恐怖力量所控制。Rico必需

programme.title: Dead in the Water
programme.desc: 当有抱负的摄影视频博主Tara被交往多年的男友甩后,她最好的朋友Amy带她去她家的湖边别墅度周末。在那里,她们遇上了一个神秘又迷人的男人,迫使她们直面自己的心魔。

programme.title: 看不见的他们
programme.desc: 一场车祸后,林月家里怪事连连。全身冰冷的姐姐在镜子里看不见家人的身影,黑夜里爸爸窥探的双眼,和每天凌晨阁楼传来的弹珠声。林月循声而上去寻找真相,却在打开阁楼的门后,发现里面紧锁的是自己的遗像…

programme.title: Central Park
programme.desc: 一班年轻人准备在中央公园狂欢一晚,却遇上杀手要将他们一一杀掉,以报复共中一位年轻人的父亲之恶行。

programme.title: 凌晨两点半2
programme.desc: 依成和朋友到聚魂灵山探险,传说山中埋著千年女尸,千年不灭之阴火,进去的人都逃不出来。凌晨两点半,依成的朋友先后突然消失。在森林搜索期间,依成进入无限轮回的灵异空间,更恐怖的事情却接踵而来…

programme.title: Mama Ghost
programme.desc: 在一个沿海小镇,Rico与Sisca发展了一段不可能的恋情,却因他们相爱而引发恶灵的出现。随著整个城镇发生连串骇人听闻的死亡事件,也揭露了隐藏多年的秘密,使到整个城镇被一股恐怖力量所控制。Rico必需

programme.title: 天下第一剑
programme.desc: 南剑丁梦豪是「天下第一剑」,却败于路过的怪和尚。丁履行诺言,跟他苦修三年石工。丁修炼期满返回家乡后,仍有不少武林人士冒名找他决战,唯丁欲隐居民间,所以坚拒一切挑战。无奈后来却要被逼与北剑再来一场生死决斗,究竟最后会是鹿死谁手?

programme.title: 冲霄楼
programme.desc: 改编自侠义小说《七侠五义》,人物繁多,情节多变,难得张彻处理得有条不紊,角色性格分明。故事讲述襄阳王在王府中,建造的冲霄楼机关密布,又广招花蝴蝶花冲、神手大圣邓车和小诸葛沈仲元等江湖侠士加盟,伺机造反。包公得悉襄阳王叛迹,乃命门生颜春敏前往调查。

programme.title: 摩登土佬
programme.desc: 这部音乐喜剧讲述青年贝小芬与好友汉堡饱在广告界内寻找真爱和成就的故事。

programme.title: 女侠卖人头
programme.desc: 侠女花碧莲爱上邻村的骆宏勋,其父花振芳去说亲,却遭骆母拒绝。碧莲深心不忿,找上骆家,把宏勋打倒来消气。后碧莲为救人而得罪赌棍万三句,万率众围杀碧莲,幸宏勋及时赶来相救。万之主人王伦知悉一切后,重金收买知府,将宏勋打下冤狱。碧莲往探监,见宏勋奄奄一息,遂只身闯进王伦练武场,大战众强徒,并取下王伦助手首级。翌日,碧莲把血淋淋的人头挂在竹竿上,到市上去叫卖,结果惊动官差,被捉进衙门

programme.title: 死角
programme.desc: 故事描述,狄龙与姜大卫游车河时,遇富家女李菁的跑车抛锚,狄载她返家,一见钟情。后李往姜之修车厂取车,再遇狄,狄约李去跳舞,夜总会中,碰见李兄陈鸿烈,陈不喜欢狄,故二人只好提早离去;归家途中,目击员警追捕逃犯,逃犯掉下之手枪,被狄检到,从此改变他的命?

programme.title: 警察
programme.desc: 梁观偕同情侣沈燕,在郊外游玩谈心时,不幸遇上歹徒劫财色,梁护花不成更惨遭毒手。梁之挚友黄国栋报仇心切,遂毅然投身警界,期有机会亲自侦缉凶手。五年后,黄因出众表现被升职之余,亦与沈日久生情;不久,因一宗离奇的谋杀案件,沈认出当年杀害梁的凶手……

programme.title: 八国联军
programme.desc: 清朝末年政局腐败,社会民不聊生,慈禧太后与一群愚昧无知的权贵大臣不但毫无抵御外国列强侵占,以及保护人民的能力,反而迷信以吞符念咒,自称无坚不摧的「义和团」可以抵御洋人,决意向列强宣战。结果导致八国联军攻陷北京,慈禧太后仓惶逃难;人民这才醒悟到,只有孙中山先生领导的革命运动,才是挽救中国的唯一希望。

programme.title: 江湖三女侠
programme.desc: 故事讲述,胸怀野心的朱天翔得知韩氏三姐妹若兰、如玫、晓莲家藏威力惊人的玄铁神剑,若能夺得,必能战胜「武林之尊」修德武馆,称霸江湖

programme.title: 武松
programme.desc: 一次醉酒后,武松赤手空拳打死一只猛虎,因此被任命为都头。武松兄长武大郎的妻子潘金莲色诱武松,但遭他拒绝。后来,潘金莲和富户西门庆有染,及后奸情败露,两人继而毒死了武大郎。武松知悉后,先杀潘金莲再杀西门庆,为兄长报仇。

programme.title: 南北狮王
programme.desc: 故事讲述以「反清复明」为号召的天地会,恐被清廷一网打尽,遂将会员名册分成两份,送往机密地点。天地会中人红娘子遇上刚直的失业捕快阿云,邀其协助把名册送到朱标的武馆去,期间遇到聪敏的棺材舖伙计阿寸,发生连串笑料。及后红被原为清廷走狗的朱所杀,云为代红执行任务,终亦重伤身亡。最后任务便落在阿寸身上,寸与朱展开连番追逐,最后为寸所杀,而寸亦身陷劣境之中

programme.title: 老夫子奇趣录
programme.desc: 电影承上集继续笑料百出。这次,大蕃薯开了一家中医诊所,但传统的中医似乎不为时髦的香港社会接受。最后得靠好友老夫子相助,为他解决疑难!

programme.title: 黄飞鸿
programme.desc: 一代宗师黄飞鸿在广东教授功夫,却被一名恶毒土匪陷害黄飞鸿的弟子,更以抢劫及谋杀等罪行诬陷他。因此,黄飞鸿誓要与土匪对抗力证自己的清白,并为弟子报仇。

programme.title: 一乐也
programme.desc: 由三个民初故事串联而成的喜剧小品,许冠文一人分饰多角,其中包括剃头学徒: 有一街坊中风而死,许代师傅守灵,为打发时间与众人在灵堂玩起「麻雀耍乐」,怎料尸体突然触电翻生!

programme.title: 血鹦鹉
programme.desc: 据说诸魔化成的血鹦鹉,看见它的人能得到三个愿望。江湖侠盗叶停枫为追寻血鹦鹉的真相;与名捕「铁手无情」铁恨联手。某夜,叶、铁二人在坟场遇上血鹦鹉,铁死于它的魔力之下;后叶将其尸体送回家乡安葬。其后,尸体却离奇失踪,叶经历重重险阻后,终于见到真正的血鹦鹉…

programme.title: 宋宫秘史
programme.desc: 包公发现刘妃在二十年前为保其位而谋害李妃,将李妃刚诞下的儿子调走后,把她逐出皇宫。于是,包公用妙计诱大太监郭槐认罪,揭发当年他与刘妃合谋陷害李妃之奸计,并将刘妃定罪。而李妃也被接回皇宫,与已为皇帝的儿子团聚。

programme.title: 宋宫秘史
programme.desc: 包公发现刘妃在二十年前为保其位而谋害李妃,将李妃刚诞下的儿子调走后,把她逐出皇宫。于是,包公用妙计诱大太监郭槐认罪,揭发当年他与刘妃合谋陷害李妃之奸计,并将刘妃定罪。而李妃也被接回皇宫,与已为皇帝的儿子团聚。

programme.title: 金毛狮王
programme.desc: 侠盗金毛狮武功高强,经常劫富济贫。一夜他遭黑帮突袭,幸遇太湖七狮,把他送往神医处救治。神医携金毛狮赴回魂谷采药治伤,却屡遭黑帮追杀,险象环生

programme.title: 青春1000日
programme.desc: 凌玫瑰与方素美是一对感情要好的同窗。凌幼失怙恃,由当舞女之姊抚养成长,方则出身富家,受母呵护备至。毕业后,凌由沦落风尘攀至选美冠军,方则满足于平淡生活中;但她们却偏偏同时爱上刘医生。最后一件意想不到的事发生,改写了他们三人的一生…

programme.title: 连城诀
programme.desc: 丁典获得秘典「神照经」及可以成为天下第一巨富的「连城诀」,且与知府凌退思的女儿霜华相恋,凌为夺秘典,将丁打下牢狱。狄云于死囚狱中认识丁,被传授「神照功」。凌狠心对女儿下毒手,丁愤然与狄越狱,结果被毒死,而「连城诀」竟然在…

programme.title: 天使出更
programme.desc: 话说医务署发觉圣慕伦医院的医疗水准及设备大有问题,原来该院院长体弱多病,院务交陈医生主理;但陈个性主观,行事不依规章,连手下一班见习医生亦各具「特性」,时闹笑话,弄至院务混乱。院长决定聘用资深护士长进行改革

programme.title: 飞狐外传
programme.desc: 十八年前,胡斐之父胡一刀,与苗人凤交换刀剑比武,被己刀伤,继而身亡,原来胡之刀早被田归农涂上毒药;苗妻南兰被田勾引,竟抛夫弃女,后田更以毒粉弄瞎苗双眼;斐见苗受此遭遇,决定代其向药王求救,亦因此碰上一生中最爱的药王传人程灵素……

programme.title: 阿牛入城记
programme.desc: 这部喜剧描述乡下人阿牛来港后,因生性戆直而经常被坏人利用。阿牛尝尽低下层社会的人情冷暖,最后更被判入狱!究竟天生乐观的他,能否吉人天相?

programme.title: 陆阿采与黄飞鸿
programme.desc: 年轻的黄飞鸿誓要证明自己有能力,可以成为父亲的习武师傅陆阿采的徒弟。虽然他在一次比武中落败,但黄飞鸿对武学的热诚终于感动了陆阿采,并得偿所愿拜他为师。

programme.title: 阿牛发达记
programme.desc: 阿牛拾得一袋珠宝,从此富贵。这时,周大叔假意叫他签约迎娶一名女子,却原来是个陷阱,为的是要卖掉他的房子。最后,可怜的阿牛又回复一贫如洗…

programme.title: 大内高手
programme.desc: 巡按御史傅秉忠因被控伪造公文而黯然回乡。在旅途中,他邂逅了武功高强的燕书棠,便请他全程护送。不久,他们又遇到了逃婚的少女史雪兰和她的丫鬟,二人恳求能同行,以求庇护。众人最终抵达一座破旧的庙宇准备过夜,却不料一进入庙门便遭到匪徒的埋伏袭击……

programme.title: 老夫子
programme.desc: 与老夫子一起经历连串的漫画故事,看他和他傻头傻脑的好友大番薯如何为抱得美人归而弄至笑话连篇!

programme.title: 五虎将
programme.desc: 一帮土匪带著劫来的保险箱到某小镇,迫铁匠韦开箱,韦却逃走报官。匪帮滥杀村民,多名义士闻讯,联手对抗众匪。

programme.title: 何日君再来
programme.desc: 电影奇才秦剑的不朽佳作,富家子音乐家爱上歌女,不理家人反对秘密结婚。后因丈夫被生活折磨而弄致失明,妻子重披歌衣上舞台。

programme.title: 书剑恩仇录
programme.desc: 乾隆原来并非皇位继承人,而在出生时被调包,但他一直被蒙在鼓里,直至地下组织红花会的人相告。而红花会总舵主陈家洛是其同胞兄弟。两弟兄因身世和利益必需身不由己地彼此对抗…

programme.title: 玉罗刹

programme.title: 非洲野狗: 族群对狮群 #5
programme.desc: 目睹卡昆比族群将一只跟踪牠们的豹子赶到树上,你会感到心跳加速。加入朱尔兹的ZCP狮子项圈任务,与侦察员西蒙一起钓鱼,探索野狗族群在进食期间的等级关系,并见证一场陪伴一只受重伤卡昆比幼崽的令人心碎的守夜。

programme.title: 颠沛流离亚马逊 #5
programme.desc: 每年有20万只秘鲁猴子被非法贩运,大部分更是婴儿。猴子岛为贩卖、合法和非法狩猎的受害者提供第二次机会。我们记录了这些年轻猴子的生存困境。

programme.title: 阿拉斯加的夏天 英普
programme.desc: 《阿拉斯加的夏天》以令人惊叹的高动态范围成像方法拍摄,展现了美国最北部州份充满活力的雄伟景致。从令人惊叹的小湾、海湾和水湾所展示巴拉诺夫岛的崎岖之美,到座头鲸和虎鲸在参天的冰川和高耸的山脉间那平静的水域中畅游的冰川湾,这是阿拉斯加与众不同的旅程。

programme.title: 猩猩成长记 #1
programme.desc: 欢迎小猩猩托潘,她是一个需要代孕妈妈照顾的孤儿。当她还在幼儿园学习之时,她的同学们已经进入了初中、高中和野外实习学校。与此同时,16岁的卡斯帕正在为毕业做著准备。

programme.title: 野性之最纽西兰 #3
programme.desc: 纽西兰有两个野生堡垒保护脆弱的土生动物: 一个是受到盐水护城河保护的偏远岛屿,另一个是被防捕食者屏障包围的山顶城堡。这是这些精致的庇护所和在其中茁壮成长的动物的故事。

programme.title: 野性之最纽西兰 #4
programme.desc: 纽西兰东岸的春天是纽西兰海狗和北方皇家信天翁的好时光。牠们已回到自己的土地准备繁殖。但因恶劣的地形、无常的天气和饥饿的掠食者使牠们的生活变得困难。只有最强者才能生存下去,并薪火相传下去。

programme.title: 大战狐?岛 #3
programme.desc: 在长期干旱过后,第一场雨的降临大大地纾缓了马达加斯加贝伦地保育区的环尾狐猴帮。森林里的食物十分充足,对立帮派领导人姬丝图和嘉缇率领族群离开领土大快朵颐。

programme.title: 南荒之地 #1
programme.desc: 新西兰南岛的西南角被巨大的山脉和蛮荒的太平洋所封闭。稀有的企鹅每天都被逼与巨型胡氏海狮进行猫捉老鼠的游戏。而海狮也生活在一个动荡的世界,幼狮必须对抗大自然才能生存下来。

programme.title: 昆虫启示录 #2
programme.desc: 了解蜜蜂、蝴蝶与飞蛾如何让田野和树林充满生机。想像如果这些勤劳的虫虫消失,世界会如何变样。见证神秘的蝴蝶迁徙之旅,以及飞蛾如何巧妙地躲避饥饿的蝙蝠。

programme.title: 野性之最纽西兰 #3
programme.desc: 纽西兰有两个野生堡垒保护脆弱的土生动物: 一个是受到盐水护城河保护的偏远岛屿,另一个是被防捕食者屏障包围的山顶城堡。这是这些精致的庇护所和在其中茁壮成长的动物的故事。

programme.title: 野性之最纽西兰 #4
programme.desc: 纽西兰东岸的春天是纽西兰海狗和北方皇家信天翁的好时光。牠们已回到自己的土地准备繁殖。但因恶劣的地形、无常的天气和饥饿的掠食者使牠们的生活变得困难。只有最强者才能生存下去,并薪火相传下去。

programme.title: 大战狐?岛 #3
programme.desc: 在长期干旱过后,第一场雨的降临大大地纾缓了马达加斯加贝伦地保育区的环尾狐猴帮。森林里的食物十分充足,对立帮派领导人姬丝图和嘉缇率领族群离开领土大快朵颐。

programme.title: 南荒之地 #1
programme.desc: 新西兰南岛的西南角被巨大的山脉和蛮荒的太平洋所封闭。稀有的企鹅每天都被逼与巨型胡氏海狮进行猫捉老鼠的游戏。而海狮也生活在一个动荡的世界,幼狮必须对抗大自然才能生存下来。

programme.title: 颠沛流离亚马逊 #5
programme.desc: 每年有20万只秘鲁猴子被非法贩运,大部分更是婴儿。猴子岛为贩卖、合法和非法狩猎的受害者提供第二次机会。我们记录了这些年轻猴子的生存困境。

programme.title: 阿拉斯加的夏天 英普
programme.desc: 《阿拉斯加的夏天》以令人惊叹的高动态范围成像方法拍摄,展现了美国最北部州份充满活力的雄伟景致。从令人惊叹的小湾、海湾和水湾所展示巴拉诺夫岛的崎岖之美,到座头鲸和虎鲸在参天的冰川和高耸的山脉间那平静的水域中畅游的冰川湾,这是阿拉斯加与众不同的旅程。

programme.title: 猩猩成长记 #1
programme.desc: 欢迎小猩猩托潘,她是一个需要代孕妈妈照顾的孤儿。当她还在幼儿园学习之时,她的同学们已经进入了初中、高中和野外实习学校。与此同时,16岁的卡斯帕正在为毕业做著准备。

programme.title: 非洲野狗: 族群对狮群 #6
programme.desc: 和卡昆比族群一起返回巢穴,这个族群正在哀悼两只失去的幼崽。偶遇一个鬣狗窝和一头狮子试图放倒一头水牛的场面,然后跟上曼齐族群的步伐,目睹牠们与一只豹子和一群愤怒大象的对峙。

programme.title: 野性之最纽西兰 #3
programme.desc: 纽西兰有两个野生堡垒保护脆弱的土生动物: 一个是受到盐水护城河保护的偏远岛屿,另一个是被防捕食者屏障包围的山顶城堡。这是这些精致的庇护所和在其中茁壮成长的动物的故事。

programme.title: 猩猩成长记 #2
programme.desc: 观察幼儿园里蓬勃发展的友谊和物种间的联系,窥探初中生瓦伦蒂诺、尤特里斯和马达拉之间的兄弟情谊。我们看到心不在焉的贝尼沉浸在对食物的热爱中,还遭到了高年级学生的殴打。

programme.title: 狗建奇工 #3
programme.desc: 本集集中在狗只与其(大部份)人类拍档间的卓越合作关系。2018年,一只德国牧羊种的搜救犬与加州特遣队和她的洛杉矶消防员拍档被部署在蒙特西托寻找破坏性泥石流意外的幸存者。在英国,土地调查犬类拍档- 西班牙猎犬与牠们的人类拍档,使用牠们的鼻子进行地下水泄漏搜索。最后,同样在英国,与一只学会阅读的聪明拉布拉多犬和牠的拍档- 校长力克加拿见面,他们帮助小学生建立信心。

programme.title: 狗建奇工 #4
programme.desc: 南非的野生海岸绵延170英里。印度和大西洋的海流汇合于此,逼使大浪涌向海岸线。这里也是驻莫桑比克的鬼蝠𫚉研究员安德里亚马歇尔希望在南非境内进行首次鬼蝠𫚉探索的地方。

programme.title: 大战狐?岛 #4
programme.desc: 狐?岛上的帮派奋力保持族群的健康和领土的完整。随著婴儿们成长,牠们的阶级架构开始出现裂缝,权力备受考验。由学习食甚么、交友、结盟到在族群中找到一席之地,狐?岛上婴儿的生活跟成年狐?一样艰辛。

programme.title: 南荒之地 #2
programme.desc: 在新西兰西南部,深邃的峡湾和潮汐形成的潟湖被绿色的雨林覆盖。生活在黑暗峡湾港的生物通常栖息在深海。随著冬季将至,宽吻海豚必须逃离牠们冰冷的峡湾,而在山河中,新西兰长鳍鳗细听大海的呼唤。

programme.desc: 保护区的猩猩六年级了,他们将面临放归野外的考验,和他们一起体验这个历程中的情绪过山车和成长痛苦。探索迪拉的命运是如何突然改变的,并观看大男孩贝尼如何应对令人讨厌的节食计划。

programme.title: 鲨王争霸战
programme.desc: 见证大白鲨群英的终极战斗!科学家们尝试从新西兰海岸外的100多条大白鲨中,挑选出领头的鲨王。一起为群雄的速度、猎食技能和无比勇气而喝采。

programme.title: 鲨王争霸战: 争雄对决
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​目睹一场前所未有、独特异常的鲨鱼竞赛,巨白鲨在令人瞠目结舌、惊心动魄的力量比拼中正面交锋。与鲨鱼专家莱利•艾略特博士(Riley Elliott)一起冒险,他努力回答这个古老问题: 究竟哪一性别才是海中最强者?

programme.title: 大战狐?岛 #5
programme.desc: 贝伦地保育区的环尾狐猴过得动荡不安,族群急忙利用早前降雨后的短暂大餐,因为随之而来又是干燥日子。随著牠们的幼崽长大,觅食的压力变得比之前更大。

programme.title: 南荒之地 #3
programme.desc: 新西兰东南岸是世上最富饶的渔场之一,也是海洋动物婴孩从新丁长大成人之地。年轻的鲸鱼、海豚和海豹学习捕猎;学习社会规则,甚至开始自己的冒险。

programme.title: 狗建奇工 #3
programme.desc: 本集集中在狗只与其(大部份)人类拍档间的卓越合作关系。2018年,一只德国牧羊种的搜救犬与加州特遣队和她的洛杉矶消防员拍档被部署在蒙特西托寻找破坏性泥石流意外的幸存者。在英国,土地调查犬类拍档- 西班牙猎犬与牠们的人类拍档,使用牠们的鼻子进行地下水泄漏搜索。最后,同样在英国,与一只学会阅读的聪明拉布拉多犬和牠的拍档- 校长力克加拿见面,他们帮助小学生建立信心。

programme.title: 昆虫启示录 #4
programme.desc: 向大自然的清洁专家学习环境卫生课。了解甲虫如何利用尖牙与毒液等生物武器,巧妙维持生态平衡,并认识超过六千种的粪金龟──这些无名英雄才是维护地球健康的关键。

programme.title: 非洲野狗: 族群对狮群 #5
programme.desc: 目睹卡昆比族群将一只跟踪牠们的豹子赶到树上,你会感到心跳加速。加入朱尔兹的ZCP狮子项圈任务,与侦察员西蒙一起钓鱼,探索野狗族群在进食期间的等级关系,并见证一场陪伴一只受重伤卡昆比幼崽的令人心碎的守夜。

programme.title: 颠沛流离亚马逊 #5
programme.desc: 每年有20万只秘鲁猴子被非法贩运,大部分更是婴儿。猴子岛为贩卖、合法和非法狩猎的受害者提供第二次机会。我们记录了这些年轻猴子的生存困境。

programme.title: 阿拉斯加的夏天 英普
programme.desc: 《阿拉斯加的夏天》以令人惊叹的高动态范围成像方法拍摄,展现了美国最北部州份充满活力的雄伟景致。从令人惊叹的小湾、海湾和水湾所展示巴拉诺夫岛的崎岖之美,到座头鲸和虎鲸在参天的冰川和高耸的山脉间那平静的水域中畅游的冰川湾,这是阿拉斯加与众不同的旅程。

programme.title: 猩猩成长记 #1
programme.desc: 欢迎小猩猩托潘,她是一个需要代孕妈妈照顾的孤儿。当她还在幼儿园学习之时,她的同学们已经进入了初中、高中和野外实习学校。与此同时,16岁的卡斯帕正在为毕业做著准备。

programme.title: 野性之最纽西兰 #3
programme.desc: 纽西兰有两个野生堡垒保护脆弱的土生动物: 一个是受到盐水护城河保护的偏远岛屿,另一个是被防捕食者屏障包围的山顶城堡。这是这些精致的庇护所和在其中茁壮成长的动物的故事。

programme.title: 野性之最纽西兰 #4
programme.desc: 纽西兰东岸的春天是纽西兰海狗和北方皇家信天翁的好时光。牠们已回到自己的土地准备繁殖。但因恶劣的地形、无常的天气和饥饿的掠食者使牠们的生活变得困难。只有最强者才能生存下去,并薪火相传下去。

programme.title: 大战狐?岛 #3
programme.desc: 在长期干旱过后,第一场雨的降临大大地纾缓了马达加斯加贝伦地保育区的环尾狐猴帮。森林里的食物十分充足,对立帮派领导人姬丝图和嘉缇率领族群离开领土大快朵颐。

programme.title: 南荒之地 #1
programme.desc: 新西兰南岛的西南角被巨大的山脉和蛮荒的太平洋所封闭。稀有的企鹅每天都被逼与巨型胡氏海狮进行猫捉老鼠的游戏。而海狮也生活在一个动荡的世界,幼狮必须对抗大自然才能生存下来。

programme.title: 颠沛流离亚马逊 #5
programme.desc: 每年有20万只秘鲁猴子被非法贩运,大部分更是婴儿。猴子岛为贩卖、合法和非法狩猎的受害者提供第二次机会。我们记录了这些年轻猴子的生存困境。

programme.title: 昆虫启示录 #2
programme.desc: 了解蜜蜂、蝴蝶与飞蛾如何让田野和树林充满生机。想像如果这些勤劳的虫虫消失,世界会如何变样。见证神秘的蝴蝶迁徙之旅,以及飞蛾如何巧妙地躲避饥饿的蝙蝠。

programme.desc: 了解蜜蜂、蝴蝶与飞蛾如何让田野和树林充满生机。想像如果这些勤劳的虫虫消失,世界会如何变样。见证神秘的蝴蝶迁徙之旅,以及飞蛾如何巧妙地躲避饥饿的蝙蝠。

programme.title: 野性之最纽西兰 #3
programme.desc: 纽西兰有两个野生堡垒保护脆弱的土生动物: 一个是受到盐水护城河保护的偏远岛屿,另一个是被防捕食者屏障包围的山顶城堡。这是这些精致的庇护所和在其中茁壮成长的动物的故事。

programme.title: 野性之最纽西兰 #4
programme.desc: 纽西兰东岸的春天是纽西兰海狗和北方皇家信天翁的好时光。牠们已回到自己的土地准备繁殖。但因恶劣的地形、无常的天气和饥饿的掠食者使牠们的生活变得困难。只有最强者才能生存下去,并薪火相传下去。

programme.title: 非洲野狗: 族群对狮群 #6
programme.desc: 和卡昆比族群一起返回巢穴,这个族群正在哀悼两只失去的幼崽。偶遇一个鬣狗窝和一头狮子试图放倒一头水牛的场面,然后跟上曼齐族群的步伐,目睹牠们与一只豹子和一群愤怒大象的对峙。

programme.title: 野性之最纽西兰 #3
programme.desc: 纽西兰有两个野生堡垒保护脆弱的土生动物: 一个是受到盐水护城河保护的偏远岛屿,另一个是被防捕食者屏障包围的山顶城堡。这是这些精致的庇护所和在其中茁壮成长的动物的故事。

programme.title: 野性之最纽西兰 #4
programme.desc: 纽西兰东岸的春天是纽西兰海狗和北方皇家信天翁的好时光。牠们已回到自己的土地准备繁殖。但因恶劣的地形、无常的天气和饥饿的掠食者使牠们的生活变得困难。只有最强者才能生存下去,并薪火相传下去。

programme.title: 猩猩成长记 #2
programme.desc: 观察幼儿园里蓬勃发展的友谊和物种间的联系,窥探初中生瓦伦蒂诺、尤特里斯和马达拉之间的兄弟情谊。我们看到心不在焉的贝尼沉浸在对食物的热爱中,还遭到了高年级学生的殴打。

programme.title: 狗建奇工 #3
programme.desc: 本集集中在狗只与其(大部份)人类拍档间的卓越合作关系。2018年,一只德国牧羊种的搜救犬与加州特遣队和她的洛杉矶消防员拍档被部署在蒙特西托寻找破坏性泥石流意外的幸存者。在英国,土地调查犬类拍档- 西班牙猎犬与牠们的人类拍档,使用牠们的鼻子进行地下水泄漏搜索。最后,同样在英国,与一只学会阅读的聪明拉布拉多犬和牠的拍档- 校长力克加拿见面,他们帮助小学生建立信心。

programme.title: 狗建奇工 #4
programme.desc: 南非的野生海岸绵延170英里。印度和大西洋的海流汇合于此,逼使大浪涌向海岸线。这里也是驻莫桑比克的鬼蝠𫚉研究员安德里亚马歇尔希望在南非境内进行首次鬼蝠𫚉探索的地方。

programme.title: 大战狐?岛 #4
programme.desc: 狐?岛上的帮派奋力保持族群的健康和领土的完整。随著婴儿们成长,牠们的阶级架构开始出现裂缝,权力备受考验。由学习食甚么、交友、结盟到在族群中找到一席之地,狐?岛上婴儿的生活跟成年狐?一样艰辛。

programme.title: 南荒之地 #2
programme.desc: 在新西兰西南部,深邃的峡湾和潮汐形成的潟湖被绿色的雨林覆盖。生活在黑暗峡湾港的生物通常栖息在深海。随著冬季将至,宽吻海豚必须逃离牠们冰冷的峡湾,而在山河中,新西兰长鳍鳗细听大海的呼唤。

programme.title: 进化的奥秘 #1
programme.desc: 您曾否想过为何山魈的脸如此七彩,秃鹰为何秃头,甚至双髻鲨为何有双髻?发掘动物如何通过脖子以上的进化来生存。

programme.title: 猩猩成长记 #3
programme.desc: 保护区的猩猩六年级了,他们将面临放归野外的考验,和他们一起体验这个历程中的情绪过山车和成长痛苦。探索迪拉的命运是如何突然改变的,并观看大男孩贝尼如何应对令人讨厌的节食计划。

programme.title: 鲨王争霸战
programme.desc: 见证大白鲨群英的终极战斗!科学家们尝试从新西兰海岸外的100多条大白鲨中,挑选出领头的鲨王。一起为群雄的速度、猎食技能和无比勇气而喝采。

programme.title: 鲨王争霸战: 争雄对决
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​目睹一场前所未有、独特异常的鲨鱼竞赛,巨白鲨在令人瞠目结舌、惊心动魄的力量比拼中正面交锋。与鲨鱼专家莱利•艾略特博士(Riley Elliott)一起冒险,他努力回答这个古老问题: 究竟哪一性别才是海中最强者?

programme.title: 大战狐?岛 #5
programme.desc: 贝伦地保育区的环尾狐猴过得动荡不安,族群急忙利用早前降雨后的短暂大餐,因为随之而来又是干燥日子。随著牠们的幼崽长大,觅食的压力变得比之前更大。

programme.title: 南荒之地 #3
programme.desc: 新西兰东南岸是世上最富饶的渔场之一,也是海洋动物婴孩从新丁长大成人之地。年轻的鲸鱼、海豚和海豹学习捕猎;学习社会规则,甚至开始自己的冒险。

programme.desc: 本集集中在狗只与其(大部份)人类拍档间的卓越合作关系。2018年,一只德国牧羊种的搜救犬与加州特遣队和她的洛杉矶消防员拍档被部署在蒙特西托寻找破坏性泥石流意外的幸存者。在英国,土地调查犬类拍档- 西班牙猎犬与牠们的人类拍档,使用牠们的鼻子进行地下水泄漏搜索。最后,同样在英国,与一只学会阅读的聪明拉布拉多犬和牠的拍档- 校长力克加拿见面,他们帮助小学生建立信心。

programme.title: 海滩生命线 #2
programme.desc: 在诺华斯高沙省的任何一个边界,证明任何海滩都是由相反的原始力量所建成,但若生命要茁壮成长,这些力量之间的平衡也是必要的。

programme.title: 猩猩成长记 #3
programme.desc: 保护区的猩猩六年级了,他们将面临放归野外的考验,和他们一起体验这个历程中的情绪过山车和成长痛苦。探索迪拉的命运是如何突然改变的,并观看大男孩贝尼如何应对令人讨厌的节食计划。

programme.title: 鲨王争霸战
programme.desc: 见证大白鲨群英的终极战斗!科学家们尝试从新西兰海岸外的100多条大白鲨中,挑选出领头的鲨王。一起为群雄的速度、猎食技能和无比勇气而喝采。

programme.title: 鲨王争霸战: 争雄对决
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​目睹一场前所未有、独特异常的鲨鱼竞赛,巨白鲨在令人瞠目结舌、惊心动魄的力量比拼中正面交锋。与鲨鱼专家莱利•艾略特博士(Riley Elliott)一起冒险,他努力回答这个古老问题: 究竟哪一性别才是海中最强者?

programme.title: 大战狐?岛 #5
programme.desc: 贝伦地保育区的环尾狐猴过得动荡不安,族群急忙利用早前降雨后的短暂大餐,因为随之而来又是干燥日子。随著牠们的幼崽长大,觅食的压力变得比之前更大。

programme.desc: 向大自然的清洁专家学习环境卫生课。了解甲虫如何利用尖牙与毒液等生物武器,巧妙维持生态平衡,并认识超过六千种的粪金龟──这些无名英雄才是维护地球健康的关键。

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #2
programme.desc: 河流是葡萄牙野生生态的生命线,连接山脉到大海。探索成年雄鹿、青蛙的春季仪式和䴙䴘的舞蹈,还有这些生机勃勃的水道沿岸上其他动物和地貌。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #10
programme.desc: 仅仅是有一点点不同,就可能带来巨大的优势,但同时也会带来极大的挑战。这些动物逆势而行,找到了独特的生存之道。

programme.title: 纳莱迪: 小象故事

programme.title: 下一站: 缅甸
programme.desc: 《下一站: 缅甸》将带领观众欣赏缅甸一些最美、最壮观的「亚洲遗产」湿地,那里有坐著渔夫的单桨舢舨和水上花园。

programme.title: 深入美洲狮三角
programme.desc: 蒙大拿州本土野生动物专家凯西安德森与野生动物电影制片人温利亚兰尼达合作拍摄了智利巴塔哥尼亚百内国家公园内的野生美洲狮。他们一起拍摄了世上其他地方看不到的东西,当中将会解开美洲狮真实本性的奥秘。

programme.title: 街头美食通 #10
programme.desc: 安斯利在美食之旅的最后一站到访问约旦的安曼,那是来自伊拉克、黎巴嫩、巴勒斯坦和叙利亚中东一族叫作家的交汇处。

programme.title: 美国道地料理大搜查 #1
programme.desc: 加州是美国境内日本人口最多的地区之一。他们在这里的生活和融入美国文化的过程并不顺利。我们在本集将揭示他们的考验、韧性和美味的健康食品。

programme.title: 美国道地料理大搜查 #2
programme.desc: 加州在美国购买之前曾被称为墨西哥。我们在圣地牙哥一尝真正的墨西哥食物,它们出自那些最懂墨西哥菜的人。我们来场啤酒之旅,品尝金钱可以买到的最好手工啤酒。

programme.title: 美国道地料理大搜查 #3
programme.desc: 迈阿密不仅靠近古巴,而且这里地道的古巴美食也很丰富。我们跟真正了解古巴的古巴人见面,看看他们在迈阿密的生活是多么甜蜜。

programme.title: 美国道地料理大搜查 #4
programme.desc: 据估计,在1820年至1930年间,多达 450 万爱尔兰人抵达美国。他们在美国的建国历程中留痕,我们边吃他们的食物边了解更多他们的历史。

programme.title: 太空灾难 #2
programme.desc: 这是太空探索中最具挑战性和危险性的阶段之一: 将太空船带回地球。数十年来,美国太空总署和苏联工程师和设计师们致力制造能够承受因重新进入大气层而造成热无可恕高温和不可思议速度的机器。

programme.title: 太空灾难 #3
programme.desc: 在太空很少出现第二次机会。当出了差错,唯有太空人和任务控制中心共同制定解决方案……而且要迅速反应。

programme.title: 太空灾难 #4
programme.desc: 美国太空总署极力培训其太空人,确保他们的身体健康、精神强大,并如最强大的机器一样可靠。不过事实是,即使是最聪明的人也会犯错……而在太空这个苛刻的环境中,任何错误,即使微不足道,都会左右生死。

programme.title: 李古查摩美国行 #6
programme.desc: 约翰与洛杉矶地头虫乔治罗培兹一起开车前往洛杉矶东部开展他的旅程。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #1
programme.desc: Ben 的美食之旅从南岛西岸展开。他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座农场遇见了全纽西兰唯一的蔓越莓生产者,接著前往布莱克波尔(Blackball)学习腊肠(chorizo)的制作过程。Ben 随后在海滩上烹调出多道结合这些在地美味的料理,并搭配当地啤酒享用。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #2
programme.desc: Ben 来到坎特伯里的高峰牧场,了解这座高地农场「从产地到餐桌」的体验,以及家族世代守护土地的故事。接著,他前往朵拉荒野海岸,拜访一对以永续方式采集海鲜的夫妇——他们以推土机将渔船推进大海,展开一天的捕捞旅程。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #3
programme.desc: Ben 来到赫斯廷斯,发现当地以整合式的全方位方法生产草饲安格斯牛肉。他造访在地农夫市集,认识了许多优秀的本地食品生产者,展现出这个地区丰饶的农产品。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #4
programme.desc: Ben 拜访了一位果园经营者与食品创新专家。他们共同的愿景��制作天然、以品种为主导的苹果汁,并采用世界最先进的技术。他也参观了位于霍克斯湾地中海型气候下所培育的超过三十种无花果。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #5
programme.desc: Ben 搭船前往阿卡罗瓦的一座鲑鱼养殖场,了解纽西兰帝王鲑与大西洋鲑的不同之处。他亲自捕捞鲑鱼,并在俯瞰港湾的海岸边烹调。他也介绍了一款高品质的本地食用油,兼具健康与多功能性,体现对本地农业与永续的承诺。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #6
programme.desc: 正值核果盛产季节!Ben 造访中奥塔哥一个由家族经营的果园,该果园以核果产季长、与土地及社区的紧密连结而闻名。他发现了一座全电力运作的樱桃农场,将优质外销樱桃直接贩售给纽西兰民众。

programme.title: 纽西兰美食故事 4 #7

programme.title: 灰熊的故事: 双孤记
programme.desc: 凯西安达臣抚养一只名叫砵突士的熊孤儿18年后,将尽一切努力确保没有熊生活在人造庇护所中。有一年,当他得知有两只灰熊幼崽成为孤儿后,他的决心受到考验。

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #1
programme.desc: 葡萄牙多元化的地貌孕育了独特的野生生态。从南部的西班牙栓皮栎森林到北部的落叶林,从交配到野外生存,跟随标志性物种所经历的关键生命阶段。

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #2
programme.desc: 河流是葡萄牙野生生态的生命线,连接山脉到大海。探索成年雄鹿、青蛙的春季仪式和䴙䴘的舞蹈,还有这些生机勃勃的水道沿岸上其他动物和地貌。

programme.title: 美国道地料理大搜查 #3
programme.desc: 迈阿密不仅靠近古巴,而且这里地道的古巴美食也很丰富。我们跟真正了解古巴的古巴人见面,看看他们在迈阿密的生活是多么甜蜜。

programme.title: 美国道地料理大搜查 #4
programme.desc: 据估计,在1820年至1930年间,多达 450 万爱尔兰人抵达美国。他们在美国的建国历程中留痕,我们边吃他们的食物边了解更多他们的历史。

programme.title: 美国道地料理大搜查 #5
programme.desc: 自由神像曾欢迎来自世界各地的数百万移民来到纽约,创造了不同文化的大熔炉。我们参观纽约市充满活力的街区,品尝这座伟大大都会提供的各种美食。

programme.title: 美国道地料理大搜查 #6
programme.desc: 洛杉矶多年来一直提倡健康生活,让人们相对容易地过上更健康的生活方式。我们在本集将仔细研究这种健康文化,了解荷里活生活的滋味。

programme.title: 美国道地料理大搜查 #7
programme.desc: 1975年越战结束后,许多越南人在三藩市定居。我们在本集遇上几位越南移民,了解他们的美国之旅,并品尝他们那些令人惊叹的正宗越南美食。

programme.title: 美国道地料理大搜查 #8
programme.desc: 没有其他菜肴比义大利菜对现代菜系有如此大影响。大批义大利人来到这里,并直接开工。他们现在受到所有人的喜爱,但并非一直如此。

programme.title: 太空灾难 #4
programme.desc: 美国太空总署极力培训其太空人,确保他们的身体健康、精神强大,并如最强大的机器一样可靠。不过事实是,即使是最聪明的人也会犯错……而在太空这个苛刻的环境中,任何错误,即使微不足道,都会左右生死。

programme.title: 太空灾难 #5
programme.desc: 在恶劣的天气中飞行是令人痛苦的经验,而对于美国太空总署来说,可说是倍感不安,因为凶猛的风暴可以不分大气层上下袭来。

programme.title: 太空灾难 #6
programme.desc: 将太空船送入轨道是一项不容有错的工作。每次发射都是长时间的受控爆炸,最小的误差可导致火爆的处境。

programme.title: 重机梦想家之基努李维 #2
programme.desc: 基努与加德获得前所未有的机会,进入全球最神秘的艺术作品之一——詹姆斯特瑞尔的〈罗登火山口〉。在这座火山口中,艺术以光与宇宙为题展开探索。

programme.title: 重机梦想家之基努李维 #3
programme.desc: 基努与加德遇见鞋履设计师欧玛贝利,他正改写运动鞋文化。欧玛的 FCTRY LAb 为音乐人与运动员创造创新鞋款,如今他将以 ARCH 为灵感设计全新靴子。

programme.title: 重机梦想家之基努李维 #4
programme.desc: 基努与加德前往斯洛维尼亚,拜访伊戈尔阿克拉波维奇——一位为 MotoGP 传奇车手打造排气系统的工程师。随著深入了解,ARCH 也将与他合作全新计划。

programme.title: 重机梦想家之基努李维 #5
programme.desc: 基努与加德遇见享誉全球的雕塑家佩姬布兰得利——她亲手摧毁自己的艺术作品,只为创造全新的表达。透过火焰与想像,她揭示创作的真谛。

programme.title: 重机梦想家之基努李维 #6
programme.desc: 基努与加德遇见马蒂罗德里格,她是 OceanX 的首席科研人员。马蒂与团队探索未知海域,揭示大自然如何启发我们的一切创造。

programme.title: 重机梦想家之基努李维 #7
programme.desc: 在挪威,前卫建筑师谢提尔托森以颠覆性的思维重新定义建筑——从可行走的歌剧院到沉入海中的餐厅,他的设计挑战我们对空间的想像。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防风少年— #7
programme.desc: 终于来到副将战,樱与十龟的对决即将开始。想起「打架就是『对话』」这番话,除了面对强者的情绪高涨外,与十龟对峙的樱,内心似乎还萌生不曾体验过的感受。十龟展现出与平时缓慢举动截然不同的敏捷身手,但他在得知一切的开端,高架桥下隧道里的真相后…。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防风少年— #8
programme.desc: 想起与兔耳山相遇后快乐的时光,在他成为头领后变了样的集团,以及自己做过的一切,十龟难掩内心迷惘。感觉到十龟的变化,樱首次在打架中产生想要了解对方的念头。两人以拳对话,带著笑容战斗的模样震撼全场,而划破场内沉默的是十龟的一句「到此结束吧」。

programme.title: 克拉龙人拉格纳 #8
programme.desc: 绯红为了追击在与拉格纳的战斗中身心皆被逼入绝境的奥偍玛蒂亚,下令炸毁王都多处。出乎意料之外的事态让奥偍玛蒂亚精神上备受打击,濒临极限状态的她虽想再次发动回溯世界的魔法,但是……。

programme.title: 克拉龙人拉格纳 #9
programme.desc: 转移失败而在雷杰王国被捕的绯红受到银器公主丝塔莉亚审问。为脱离险境,绯红使出浑身解数以高超演技进行交涉。但丝塔莉亚卓越的敏锐感受力,看穿了她的危险本质。在千钧一发之际醒来的拉格纳化解了眼前危机,但丝塔莉亚的样子却在见到拉格纳后变得不对劲。

programme.desc: 宇宙产业大公司贝纳里特集团经营著阿斯提卡西亚高等专门学园。来自水星的转学生苏莱塔・墨丘利为即将展开的校园新生活雀跃不已。然而就在快到达学校时,她发现有一道身影漂浮于宇宙中。

programme.desc: 乌野高中和音驹高中有一场练习赛,而音驹高中不断地研究日向的战术。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防风少年— #8
programme.desc: 想起与兔耳山相遇后快乐的时光,在他成为头领后变了样的集团,以及自己做过的一切,十龟难掩内心迷惘。感觉到十龟的变化,樱首次在打架中产生想要了解对方的念头。两人以拳对话,带著笑容战斗的模样震撼全场,而划破场内沉默的是十龟的一句「到此结束吧」。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防风少年— #9
programme.desc: 兔耳山深信只要打赢梅宫,获得防风铃与自由,就能变得比谁都要「快乐」。他乘势持续攻击梅宫,却没有对他造成丝毫伤害。无法理解梅宫所说的「你的拳头太弱,因为没有背负任何东西」的兔耳山,在受到梅宫全力一击后,浮现脑海的是开怀大笑的狮子头连成员们。

programme.title: 克拉龙人拉格纳 #10
programme.desc: 银装兵团为了从翼之血族的包围中逃脱而召开了作战会议。在被拉格纳说服后,丝塔莉亚决定让他及绯红加入银装兵团的主力部队,并重新为迎战奥鲁特佐拉及达拉迪克多拉进行准备。另一方面,在王都被逼入绝境的奥偍玛蒂亚,仍未从对拉格纳的恐惧中振作起来。

programme.desc: 拉格纳为了将银气注入武器,和银装兵团团员们进行了一场交流。而绯红则为了让众人从翼之血族的包围中逃脱,著手协助完成转移魔法阵。正当每个人各自都在逐步为战斗做准备时,史莱姆踩到了赫泽拉与克蕾雅的地雷,一场出人意料之外的悲剧正等著他。

programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下错车,弄得满身伤痕、万劫不复,惟有祂并不介意我们的过去,愿意领我们走向美好的将来。《如果还有明天5我为上帝精彩过》,深入中国广西山区孤儿院,记录残障青年在信仰中找回尊严和盼望的故事。摄制队再远赴南半球,见证澳洲天生失明女歌手及轮椅上的妈妈,突破身体局限活出主爱无限;还有美国摘冠

programme.title: 主日讲坛-中国基督教播道会同福堂
programme.desc: 中国基督教播道会同福堂 讲题:三种人 人每一天都要面对很多抉择,要将上帝的智慧应用在生活不同层面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧师和传道人的讲道中,往往都能够得到启迪。透过主日讲坛,更明白神的道并在生活中寻求到神喜悦的心意。

programme.title: 麦希真牧师 末了的话 美好的工作
programme.desc: 麦希真牧师:「我是八十三岁很老很老的基督工人,『还有末了的话』(林后13:11)要告诉你们。你们都是主要大用的基督工人,若稍为留心这些十分重要『末了的话』,也许有一点助益的。」麦希真牧师将《末了的话》分成八个部分共34个题目,此部为《美好的工作》。

programme.title: 来!为这城祷告

programme.title: 《天下华人唱出好诗歌大赛》大赛
programme.desc: 由影音使团、香港福音盛会、华福会香港区委会、以勒基金主办,创世电视首届「天下华人唱出好诗歌」大赛,冠军即将诞生。世上最美的声音,是生命重生的声音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位参加者,一年训练、成长、比并、同行,要成为祝福城市的好声音。

programme.title: 喜乐婆婆会客室

programme.title: 香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
香港早晨粤 及 交通消息粤
高朋满座#21粤
programme.desc: 高丽突然来到药房，高庆不敢相见。高丽更跑上高家，蕙婷遇上高丽，二人神秘地乘搭的士离去。蕙婷失踪，电话中却传来蕙婷呼救的声音，闭路电视看到蕙婷向高丽求饶。蕙婷入院，众人竟因此揭破高丽来港的真正目的。

programme.title: 锦心似玉#32粤普
programme.desc: 二夫人欲作画给二爷，秦姨娘推荐二夫人找彦行帮忙。后来太夫人知道彦行为区家人，大为不满，要十一娘退出仙绫阁，禁足于西跨院，二娘向太夫人说情，太夫人本已心软，但秦姨娘火上加油，让太夫人决定好好管束十一娘。

programme.title: 交易现场粤 及 潮流生活志粤
阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 顺德街市有售各种港人少见的食材，鼎爷带拍档见识摊档贩卖的新鲜鳄鱼肉、活生生蝎子。不过，阿谭却似乎对「家常」鲮鱼滑更感兴趣。鼎爷于是带来「手切鲮鱼滑酿豆角」，鲮鱼滑以三种刀功切成多重口感，再混合冬菇粒、虾米粒酿入豆角环，滋味加倍升华！来到本地街市，鼎爷讲解多款蛏子的分别，还应阿谭要求炮制一道「豆瓣酱爆蛏子」。吃海鲜谨记注重卫生，蛏子不单要切开洗净内脏与秽物，更要留意火候，才可保持肉质爽嫩。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 「呼吸道合胞病毒」(RSV)是常见的呼吸道病毒，为何婴幼儿特别易感染，更会增加患上哮喘的风险？妇产科医生提醒家长留意年幼子女的状况，减低延误治疗的可能性，较理想是怀孕中后期就接种疫苗保护婴儿。曾参加《剪裁魔法师2》的时装设计师王业凡带同作品到临受访，并示范怎样用丝巾搭配，衬托出不同感觉；他还会分享于农历年的配衬小技巧。盐焗鸡要在家做，有点麻烦？大可随「睇𩠌食饭」李文星师傅的做法，家中亦能简易烹煮。

programme.title: 健康必杀食粤
programme.desc: 家禽类的蛋、海产类的卵，都极具营养价值。衍峰、林秀怡、陈诗欣、林钰洧开展寻卵之行，由「大食到细」！鹅蛋的营养和卡路里，是鸡蛋的三倍，简单煎荷包蛋已甚滋味。到鸡场寻找孖黄蛋，秀怡、钰洧竟被吓到鸡飞狗走？中式燕窝鸽蛋糖水，养颜之选；法式鹌鹑蛋伴鱼子酱牛肉他他，口感如何？蛋是百搭食材，大厨陈国强带来不一样的九肚鱼老烧蛋、川味蒸水蛋；陈晓桦则选用有益心血管健康的乌鱼子，及富美颜功效的白子，烹调卡邦尼意粉。

programme.title: 陪著你走#14粤PG
programme.desc: 天从摸出照片，得何娜解释知道是她与导生常出现的地方。言重找莎莉翻译点字，又把电子蒸笼放到天从公司的茶水间。3L同事在《双战》首映跟言重拥抱慰问，天从感言重地位重要。言重边吃爆谷，边将戏中画面告诉天从。

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 小丸子看见百惠穿大红色晚装很漂亮，于是自己也打扮到全身红色，更遇上同样一身火红的青年音乐人。藤木发现蓝色能代表自己，更是很好的颜色，于是打扮到一身蓝色，却意外吸引到一名女生的目光。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 民安队是保安局辖下的辅助部队，工作范围广泛，其中一项是紧急救援行动。「Kids’ Notes」请来两位队员，展示民安队的基本装备，并介绍近年引入的新科技，如何协助搜救任务。两位队员最难忘的拯救行动都是与山岭有关，究竟远足人士在「衣、食、行、急」方面可怎样做好？嘉宾提醒观众切忌独自远足，也要预先下载官方行山应用程式及相关离线地图，以便记录行程。此外，他们亦为大家推荐易行的亲子郊游路线。

programme.title: 魔神创造传粤日
programme.desc: 炎上太阳开始升空，阿渡和阿驱设法阻止，并从御富良院的影片得到启发，想到用水龙头把炎上能量释放。善意的留言令玛萝苏醒并化身天照大神，众人合力之下，最终成功消灭炎上太阳并击败炎上达。

programme.title: 财经新闻粤
programme.desc: 紧贴市况，逢交易日下午5时50分报道当日本港和外围股市行情，以及重点财经新闻。

programme.title: 利嘉阁地产45 周年真盘源特约：今日有楼睇粤 及 潮流生活志粤
programme.desc: 油塘海边一个新盘，验楼师发现，外墙有空心砖，浴室也有石材崩花，如何执修？

programme.title: 六点半新闻报道粤
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六点半，报道本地、两岸及国际重要新闻。

programme.title: 世界观粤 及 天气报告粤
东张西望粤
programme.desc: 更多司机遇过疑似撞车敲诈，节目组综合求助者提供的线索，发现索偿一方疑似联同律师行、医疗机构以集团式运作。市民拍到白鹭安静待在钓鱼人士身旁，似在等待喂食，画面有趣；生态专家提醒公众切勿喂饲。继续报道美孚某天桥底婆婆疑用纸皮霸位牟利，摄制队连日追踪，发现她们不仅拾纸皮霸位，还有人在公众地方售卖二手衣物。外景主持现身访问婆婆，对方否认图利行为。《声秀》学员毕业演唱会圆满举行，众人受访分享感受。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱． 回家之开心速递#2728粤
programme.desc: 大四喜应邀为某间公司的周年晚宴表演，却因家聪准备不足而出错。众人责怪家聪办事不力，家聪趁机辞去经理人的职务。大四喜急需找人顶替家聪，偶然发现一位合适人选。新经理人「落力」为大四喜打点一切，并安排众人参与不同活动，敢威等人却因此备受折磨。树根终于忍无可忍，将新经理人辞退。后来，树根物色到另一位合适的经理人人选，遂带此人往见敢威等人，认为其他人亦会赞成他的提议，讵料……

programme.title: 非常检控观#3粤PG
programme.desc: 湘言被控非礼，却称新弥是其失踪丈夫文贵利，重投警队的熊飞接手此案。希仁、熊飞推断新弥有可能整容及改名换姓。希仁为见新弥，出席家族饭局，其母赵舟警告不可得罪新弥这个代言人，希仁却设法试探他。湘言突然认罪，希仁等要查出个中原因……湘言其后态度大变，拒绝与众人合作。希仁查到湘言曾经流产，怀疑此事另有内情。希仁等为搜证出席拍卖会，希仁重遇嫂子王颂星，两人曾有一段旧情。逸桐替熊飞办事，取得新弥的身份证……

programme.title: 宿敌契约#22粤普PG
programme.desc: 戏阳不信杀父兄的是慕容父子，随歌再醒来视一笑为敌，安姑劝一笑离开，一笑想起随歌说过的话，自己答应不会离开。太后眼见静炎不听话便拉拢静石，承阳要沈务查平城死因，为唤起随歌记忆，一笑握著随歌的剑锋刺自己…

programme.title: 聚大金凤呈献:在家宴客60道菜粤
programme.desc: 中国人认为猪手寓意「横财就手」，肥妈带来葡式煮意，既有特色亦适合于佳节宴客。用海味待客更显矜贵，许美德师傅以新派潮州菜手法炮制金蚝。他特别以龙须丝、虾胶包裹金蚝再下锅油炸，可带出蚝的香味之余，同时保留蚝汁精华。鼎爷将咸酸梅、梅酒梅子剁碎混合成酱，为蒸蛏子提鲜，做法简单易学，垫底的粉丝更是吸尽鲜味。广东人宴客多会准备「靓汤」，帜哥呈献川芎天麻炖鱼头。想要炖出滋味汤品，原来用水亦有讲究，帜哥有何见解？

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 环球新闻档案粤
programme.desc: 节目主要以当日的娱乐新闻作重点，让你瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈动态和最新消息，并以「娱乐大事件」、「抢闸头条」、「出炉猛料」等为主题作头条新闻式报道。

programme.title: 晚间新闻粤
programme.desc: 报道本地、两岸、国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向。

programme.title: 天气报告粤 及 潮流生活志粤
名媛望族#27粤
programme.desc: 尔嫣出庭说出事实，终令卓万脱罪。卓万向儿子表示，曾爵士放弃提名他入定例局。尔嫣写了休书要求卓万签名，卓万拒绝。尔熹到来指日辉自杀，请尔嫣劝阻，卓万阻止。子君把尔嫣偷运到教堂，让尔嫣见日辉，被浩颐发现。

programme.desc: 家禽类的蛋、海产类的卵，都极具营养价值。衍峰、林秀怡、陈诗欣、林钰洧开展寻卵之行，由「大食到细」！鹅蛋的营养和卡路里，是鸡蛋的三倍，简单煎荷包蛋已甚滋味。到鸡场寻找孖黄蛋，秀怡、钰洧竟被吓到鸡飞狗走？中式燕窝鸽蛋糖水，养颜之选；法式鹌鹑蛋伴鱼子酱牛肉他他，口感如何？蛋是百搭食材，大厨陈国强带来不一样的九肚鱼老烧蛋、川味蒸水蛋；陈晓桦则选用有益心血管健康的乌鱼子，及富美颜功效的白子，烹调卡邦尼意粉。

programme.title: 陪著你走#14粤PG
programme.desc: 天从摸出照片，得何娜解释知道是她与导生常出现的地方。言重找莎莉翻译点字，又把电子蒸笼放到天从公司的茶水间。3L同事在《双战》首映跟言重拥抱慰问，天从感言重地位重要。言重边吃爆谷，边将戏中画面告诉天从。

programme.title: 高朋满座#21粤

programme.title: 锦心似玉#32粤普

programme.desc: 城安因瑞素影响而濒临失业，只好尝试寻找兼职以维持生计，却屡屡碰壁。此时，城安偶然遇上李莫仇。莫仇原来与城安处境相同，她出资要求城安协助她佯装上班，以瞒骗亲人。危机得以解除，莫仇介绍城安加入一个「失业」群组。城安因此发现商机，决定开设公司，帮助其他失业人士「扮工」；创业初期十分成功，但后来出现了「员工」流失的问题。城安设法解决，成功扭转局面，凌凌却察觉到不妥……

programme.title: 非常检控观#4粤PG
programme.desc: 文贵利与前女友所生的女儿文晶晶疑偷偷来港，湘言找新弥探问其下落，但不果，担心下向熊飞求助，熊飞成功让她对新弥死心。湘言收到讯息，往酒店等待与新弥会面，那里却发生堕楼案。湘言被当成疑犯，颂星出任其辩护律师，希仁怀疑颂星另有目的。熊飞向认识死者张诗雅的逸桐打探消息，追查下发现诗雅死前曾见过晶晶……颂星提出以精神错乱作为湘言的抗辩理由，湘言却仍起用颂星。熊飞找到新弥褓姆车的定位纪录，循这线索追寻晶晶……

programme.title: 宿敌契约#23粤普PG

programme.title: 交易现场粤 及 潮流生活志粤
阿爷厨房粤
programme.desc: 「糖葱饼」是不少港人的儿时小食。来到据称是糖葱饼发源地的汕头陈店镇福潭村，鼎爷带阿谭一睹只用砂糖与麦芽糖的糖葱饼制作工序，饼中的孔洞竟是靠师傅徒手拉出！返回厨房，鼎爷巧制以砂糖当主角的潮式甜品「反沙芋」，还加入芝麻与芫荽做出变奏版，甜中多添一分香味。二人又往衡山市场寻找摊档「西施」，可有收获？要煮出皮肉软腍的「咸菜黄豆焖猪手」，关火焗煮才是关键！试吃期间，鼎爷教拍档品尝菜式的「极品位」，会是甚么？

programme.title: 汇丰Premier Elite 呈献：汇丰Premier Elite财富汇谈粤
programme.desc: 金融市场瞬息万变，加上科技发展日新月异，如何影响投资市场？《汇丰Premier Elite财富汇谈》，云集不同行业专家，剖析市场趋势，讲解金融、投资及理财等话题，务求做到深入浅出，聚焦分析不同议题，为大家捕捉市场先机。

programme.title: 流行都市粤
programme.desc: 《流行都市》为观众介绍时令产品、健康养生、健体运动、护肤化妆、时尚服饰、婴幼儿护理、育儿知识、城中美食、饲养宠物等潮流资讯，内容包罗万有！主持们亲身体验、示范或测试之外，还会邀请嘉宾带来相关专业知识。烹饪环节方面，多位手势了得的厨艺专家轮流登场，示范简单美味的健康美食、家常小菜，替大家解决煮食烦恼。

programme.title: 健康必杀食粤
programme.desc: 黑色食物有助抗衰老、增强免疫力，部份还有补肾、降血压等功效。林秀怡、林钰洧伸手入神秘箱摸食材，吓到花容失色；紧接往农场寻找肥美乌鸡，原来秘诀在于鸡胸？除了竹丝鸡、乌金鸡，陈国强还选配黑豆、黑芝麻、黑蒜、海参等材料，煮出两𩠌一汤。衍峰、钰洧结伴享用矜贵大餐，黑松露特饮、鱼子酱蛋糕够惊喜，黑鲍鱼更被指可抗癌。花青素具抗氧化作用，秀怡与黄美棋下田即摘即食红菜头、紫旺菜，再请湛锦钿炮制紫色浓汤与紫薯鸡卷。

programme.title: 陪著你走#16粤
programme.desc: 廷晋被爆秘婚，白叔劝秀玄勿学廷晋，何娜决定不再当秀玄助手。言重带天从去跑步，天从觉得他应回去做创作人。言重找到一些香港旅游地方，要陪天从看世界。言重出门发现小纸袋，打开后明白天从用意，决定上班去……

programme.title: 樱桃小丸子粤日
programme.desc: 野口弄丢了笑话笔记，心情低落，适逢其生日将至，小丸子打算送礼物让她恢复好心情。阿良表哥带同妻子来探望小丸子一家，后者却与姐姐吵架，阿良见状提议四人分成两组，各自游玩完再集合。

programme.title: Hands Up粤
programme.desc: 头小小、身躯庞大、站在冰块上，这集「Artspiration」绘画导师所画的是甚么动物？再加四肢、五官，以及其口中捕猎的小鱼，不难猜出是北极熊吧！只有一只未免太孤单，在旁画多一个「朋友」，还有跃出水面的鱼，画面更丰富。有人透过美食寻找快乐，而主持们只是口中聊起对咖喱、��翼、肉酱意粉等美食的喜好，都不禁眉飞色舞。「开心SHARE」的投稿者又喜爱吃甚么晚餐？无辣不欢的Tiffany姐姐更似乎找到同好？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粤日
programme.desc: 由于许久没有举行演唱会，爱里与琳琳的组合AISMIRIN’ 人气开始下滑。二人继而决定举行告别演唱会，趁组合还有热度风光毕业。可是，AISMIRIN’至今仍未能够使出人气萤光幻彩变身，如此一来，想风光毕业几乎是不可能。

东张西望粤
programme.desc: 《东张西望》星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事、趣闻逸事，并报道娱乐圈最新动态、艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮。「今日突发」环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事、社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家。

programme.title: 黄道益活络油呈献：爱． 回家之开心速递#2730粤
programme.desc: 城安、凌凌、壮与璟风相约出埠旅行，却因某些理由一再延期，最后终于落实出发日期。另一方面，凌凌发现鲸吞天厦的后楼梯堆放大量杂物，向璟风反映，璟风承诺会处理。不久，杂物果然被清理，路小小却提到璟风是因瑞素之故才迅速着人处理。城安有见及此，遂借瑞素的名义向璟风「揾着数」，成功与凌凌、壮取得不少好处……旅行前一天，璟风发现自己遭城安等人利用而责怪众人，城安等却反指璟风重色轻友，双方不欢而散……

programme.title: 非常检控观#5粤PG
programme.desc: 希仁怀疑新弥与诗雅曾有联络，欲查找证据，颂星阻止并协助新弥化解危机。颂星为湘言保释，希仁受公众责难。晶晶获寻回并送院，疑被喂食药物。希仁感错怪颂星，颂星不屑他与家族作对。诗雅死前曾于庆历集团收购的网站投稿，疑是指控新弥，希仁托徒弟庞善昱查找投稿遭拒。晶晶醒后称甚么也记不起，熊飞找到关键录音，与希仁鼓励她说出真相。希仁决定检控新弥，颂星出任新弥的代表律师，她与希仁针锋相对，扬言在庭上将肆意盘问晶晶！

programme.title: 宿敌契约#24粤普PG
programme.desc: 景太后见静炎对戏阳极为上心，欲暗中除去戏阳，不料戏阳早有察觉，反借静炎之力将刺客一一除去。随歌得知承阳一直暗中调查先帝遇害之事，随即秘密约见承阳，将先帝遇害的真相、庄太后与慕容父子所为，一一告知承阳。

programme.title: 聚大金凤呈献:在家宴客60道菜粤
programme.desc: 中国人讲究不时不食，许美德师傅以「当造」萝卜煮鲳鱼，并加入老菜脯油、蒜仔等突显潮州风味。为了矜贵的老菜脯油，嘉欣即席相亲？用名贵食材宴客更显体面，鼎爷煎蛋角加入鹅肝，外型犹如金元宝，色香味俱全。肥妈以猪腩肉煸出猪油煮南瓜，放入豆豉、蜜糖调味，嘉欣称赞是下饭佳肴。Jacques(积奇)用西洋菜煮西式浓汤，既有中汤的香味，还添上一份忌廉的幼滑口感。嘉欣好奇何以个别餐厅的西餐汤过于浓稠，积奇为她释疑。

programme.title: 娱乐头条粤 及 环球新闻档案粤

programme.title: 天气报告粤 及 潮流生活志粤

programme.desc: 廷亨中风，百锵告知卓万由他代理发展的事。启燊夫妇带木水野餐，木水见小由依偎启燊，妒忌；卓万问启燊季福全档案在哪，木水听是小由父亲之事有所盘算。小由求签，木水见是下下签把签换了；小由得知，怀疑木水装傻。

programme.title: 季节限定 秋冬粤
programme.desc: 除了踏单车，长洲还有甚么新奇玩意？嘉宾林泳淘推介岛上西湾的庄园，大玩吊桥、飞索等历奇设施，还可一尝露营乐趣。如嫌火锅热气，不妨享用八鲜蒸锅。主持们逐层细味八种海鲜的滋味，大擦一餐！秋天天色特别蔚蓝？落日亦较美？专家以科学角度解构秋天天文资讯。柿子生津止渴、健脾益胃，是秋冬时令水果之一，原来还有富有柿、芝麻柿、西条柿等多个品种。「厨房男神」闻得辰哥哥爱吃柿，特意采用素鸡、带子搭配杮子，炮制两道佳肴。

programme.title: 季节限定 秋冬粤
programme.desc: 新会特产陈皮远近驰名，但原来不同时段采摘新会柑，其叫法与效用均有分别！主持们走访新会柑园、陈皮厂，见识新会柑制成陈皮的过程，细味柑普茶的芳香；又相约识食识煮的陈炜品尝陈皮宴。跟亲朋好友举行圣诞派对，怎能缺少精美的圣诞蛋糕和曲奇？留意今集好介绍！也可考虑DIY独一无二的圣诞花圈，为场地增添佳节气氛。嘉宾宋熙年还请教花艺师制作煲呔、襟花、手镯等应节花饰。另外，「汤水达人」会奉上滋润糖水「黄耳腰果奶」。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心机渣男出轨妻子闺蜜为夺下豪门不择手段！】人人称羡的模范夫妻申明燮与韩善珠，在纪念婚礼当天揭开了幸福假象。出身豪门的善珠外表完美，内心却藏著被背叛的恐惧；出身贫寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻转人生却陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美罗，不仅成为他的灵魂寄托，更在命运的捉弄下与善珠结为好友。当真相逐步揭开，爱与恨、正宫与小三的界线逐渐模糊，一场婚礼，也预告了一场悲剧的开始。

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心机渣男出轨妻子闺蜜为夺下豪门不择手段！】人人称羡的模范夫妻申明燮与韩善珠，在纪念婚礼当天揭开了幸福假象。出身豪门的善珠外表完美，内心却藏著被背叛的恐惧；出身贫寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻转人生却陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美罗，不仅成为他的灵魂寄托，更在命运的捉弄下与善珠结为好友。当真相逐步揭开，爱与恨、正宫与小三的界线逐渐模糊，一场婚礼，也预告了一场悲剧的开始。

programme.title: 妈妈要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任劳任怨大半辈子的慈母觉醒切割贪财不孝子】因丈夫早逝，独自抚养四名子女的尹正爱，就如同天下所有的妈妈一样，为了孩子总是愿意牺牲自己，一路从路边的菜贩打拼，多年后与大女儿允姬开了间点心餐厅。正当一切都看似幸福美满时，孩子们的婚姻、事业、学业纷纷出现状况，在面对问题时儿女们总持相反意见，并只贪图母亲的遗产，让正爱深感背叛，在朋友的劝说下，正爱打算不再以孩子为生活重心，并在缘分安排下开始了第二春。

programme.title: 追踪者
programme.desc: 【国税厅版文森佐任时完热血复仇】全台首播，任职于顶尖会计事务所的黄东柱，实力超群，年纪轻轻就坐上组长的位子，在父亲坠海身亡以意外结案后，整理遗物的东柱发现，纪录大企业逃税的本子凭空消失了，他火速考上地方国税局。靠著揭发知名球星的逃税案，立马成为国税局的当红炸子鸡，本以为能离真相更近，却被调职到「国税厅5局」，这个被大家称作垃圾场的单位，而他又该如何率领团队深入调查，找到真正的杀父仇人呢?

programme.title: 欧若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落难千金嫁到三位「恶婆婆」家，受尽欺辱却迷的两位男神团团转！】该剧以豪爽纯洁的爱情故事继续展开，故事发生在大公司名门之女欧若拉遇见与三个姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小说家黄玛玛。

programme.desc: 【国税厅版文森佐任时完热血复仇】全台首播，任职于顶尖会计事务所的黄东柱，实力超群，年纪轻轻就坐上组长的位子，在父亲坠海身亡以意外结案后，整理遗物的东柱发现，纪录大企业逃税的本子凭空消失了，他火速考上地方国税局。靠著揭发知名球星的逃税案，立马成为国税局的当红炸子鸡，本以为能离真相更近，却被调职到「国税厅5局」，这个被大家称作垃圾场的单位，而他又该如何率领团队深入调查，找到真正的杀父仇人呢?

programme.title: 欧若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落难千金嫁到三位「恶婆婆」家，受尽欺辱却迷的两位男神团团转！】该剧以豪爽纯洁的爱情故事继续展开，故事发生在大公司名门之女欧若拉遇见与三个姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小说家黄玛玛。

programme.title: 妈妈要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任劳任怨大半辈子的慈母觉醒切割贪财不孝子】因丈夫早逝，独自抚养四名子女的尹正爱，就如同天下所有的妈妈一样，为了孩子总是愿意牺牲自己，一路从路边的菜贩打拼，多年后与大女儿允姬开了间点心餐厅。正当一切都看似幸福美满时，孩子们的婚姻、事业、学业纷纷出现状况，在面对问题时儿女们总持相反意见，并只贪图母亲的遗产，让正爱深感背叛，在朋友的劝说下，正爱打算不再以孩子为生活重心，并在缘分安排下开始了第二春。

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心机渣男出轨妻子闺蜜为夺下豪门不择手段！】人人称羡的模范夫妻申明燮与韩善珠，在纪念婚礼当天揭开了幸福假象。出身豪门的善珠外表完美，内心却藏著被背叛的恐惧；出身贫寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻转人生却陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美罗，不仅成为他的灵魂寄托，更在命运的捉弄下与善珠结为好友。当真相逐步揭开，爱与恨、正宫与小三的界线逐渐模糊，一场婚礼，也预告了一场悲剧的开始。

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 追踪者

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【话题冠军韩剧，正义检察官池晟孤军奋战寻找真凶！！】最强正义检察官朴政宇，被冤枉杀害妻女入狱及事件发生后失去了记忆，成为了被告人。为了洗刷背负的嫌疑罪名而不得不在狱中拼凑记忆与找出杀害妻女的真凶，这时他也进入人生最糟糕的两难选择，陷入检察官的斗争中。

programme.title: 依法相爱吧
programme.desc: 【李升基×李世荣二次合作，青梅竹马谱出律政罗曼史！！】改编自人气网路小说，「怪物天才检察官」金正浩与「韩国小姐出身律师」金琉璃，青梅竹马重逢后，一起经营「LawCafé」的故事。既是律师事务所、又是咖啡馆的小天地里，用温暖的饮品与犀利的法律智慧，帮助无数人伸张正义。从法庭到日常，辩论化为斗嘴，正义化为浪漫，疗愈又甜蜜的爱情由此展开。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道总裁《飞狐外传》林雨申恋上俏邻居《光芒》蔡文静！】吴忧因车祸意外放男友鸽子惨遭分手，而同样在这场车祸中丧命的是雅曼生物科技总裁何西亚的未婚妻陆芸。吴忧分手后寄情于工作，投入新职场认识了陆芸的妹妹陆蔓，成为了闺蜜。在公事上与何西亚有了合作，不打不相识的这对欢喜冤家，好不容易发展成为恋人,此时发现陆芸在他们之间串连起来的缘分…

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 【话题冠军韩剧，正义检察官池晟孤军奋战寻找真凶！！】最强正义检察官朴政宇，被冤枉杀害妻女入狱及事件发生后失去了记忆，成为了被告人。为了洗刷背负的嫌疑罪名而不得不在狱中拼凑记忆与找出杀害妻女的真凶，这时他也进入人生最糟糕的两难选择，陷入检察官的斗争中。

programme.title: 步步惊心
programme.desc: 那一天，张晓的命运被一场车祸彻底改写。她眼看著那辆失控的卡车将自己的灵魂撞出了躯体，而她，既没有进医院也没有进天堂，却是被撞进了清朝的宫廷中。就像铺天盖地的穿越小说里写的那样，张晓的灵魂跨过时间的隧道，在一个叫马尔泰.若曦的十六岁清朝女孩的体内，重生了…时年，康熙第四十三。天下太平，但一场震动历史的「九龙夺嫡」正在暗潮涌动。权利的厮杀，爱情的灼烧，在被无限放大的历史舞台上，张晓，不，是马尔泰•若曦的命运无可避免的与众位亲王阿哥们交织在一起…她知道自己不该卷入这场九王夺嫡的争斗中，可心不由己，因为这里有她所爱的，也有爱著她的…若曦最后选择的究竟是温润如玉的八阿哥，还是面冷心热的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人?等历史的风云过后，可以陪她看夕阳西下、云卷云舒的又将是谁？

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心机渣男出轨妻子闺蜜为夺下豪门不择手段！】人人称羡的模范夫妻申明燮与韩善珠，在纪念婚礼当天揭开了幸福假象。出身豪门的善珠外表完美，内心却藏著被背叛的恐惧；出身贫寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻转人生却陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美罗，不仅成为他的灵魂寄托，更在命运的捉弄下与善珠结为好友。当真相逐步揭开，爱与恨、正宫与小三的界线逐渐模糊，一场婚礼，也预告了一场悲剧的开始。

programme.title: 奔跑吧蔷薇
programme.desc: 【纨裤子弟情留落难千金，寻觅守护爱情的甜蜜配方】过著丰食无缺没有大小姐架子的蔷薇。一场家中巨变，面临相亲结婚丈夫的背叛，经济困境及失去原生家庭的后盾。困境中凭著对料理的热情及新生活，与食品公司会长的孙子相恋，奔向对方的路上还会遇上什么样的考验?

programme.title: 女王之家
programme.desc: 【心机渣男出轨妻子闺蜜为夺下豪门不择手段！】人人称羡的模范夫妻申明燮与韩善珠，在纪念婚礼当天揭开了幸福假象。出身豪门的善珠外表完美，内心却藏著被背叛的恐惧；出身贫寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻转人生却陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美罗，不仅成为他的灵魂寄托，更在命运的捉弄下与善珠结为好友。当真相逐步揭开，爱与恨、正宫与小三的界线逐渐模糊，一场婚礼，也预告了一场悲剧的开始。

programme.title: 妈妈要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任劳任怨大半辈子的慈母觉醒切割贪财不孝子】因丈夫早逝，独自抚养四名子女的尹正爱，就如同天下所有的妈妈一样，为了孩子总是愿意牺牲自己，一路从路边的菜贩打拼，多年后与大女儿允姬开了间点心餐厅。正当一切都看似幸福美满时，孩子们的婚姻、事业、学业纷纷出现状况，在面对问题时儿女们总持相反意见，并只贪图母亲的遗产，让正爱深感背叛，在朋友的劝说下，正爱打算不再以孩子为生活重心，并在缘分安排下开始了第二春。

programme.title: 追踪者
programme.desc: 【国税厅版文森佐任时完热血复仇】全台首播，任职于顶尖会计事务所的黄东柱，实力超群，年纪轻轻就坐上组长的位子，在父亲坠海身亡以意外结案后，整理遗物的东柱发现，纪录大企业逃税的本子凭空消失了，他火速考上地方国税局。靠著揭发知名球星的逃税案，立马成为国税局的当红炸子鸡，本以为能离真相更近，却被调职到「国税厅5局」，这个被大家称作垃圾场的单位，而他又该如何率领团队深入调查，找到真正的杀父仇人呢?

programme.title: 欧若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落难千金嫁到三位「恶婆婆」家，受尽欺辱却迷的两位男神团团转！】该剧以豪爽纯洁的爱情故事继续展开，故事发生在大公司名门之女欧若拉遇见与三个姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小说家黄玛玛。

programme.desc: 【心机渣男出轨妻子闺蜜为夺下豪门不择手段！】人人称羡的模范夫妻申明燮与韩善珠，在纪念婚礼当天揭开了幸福假象。出身豪门的善珠外表完美，内心却藏著被背叛的恐惧；出身贫寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻转人生却陷入外遇泥沼。而第三者尹美罗，不仅成为他的灵魂寄托，更在命运的捉弄下与善珠结为好友。当真相逐步揭开，爱与恨、正宫与小三的界线逐渐模糊，一场婚礼，也预告了一场悲剧的开始。

programme.title: 追踪者
programme.desc: 【国税厅版文森佐任时完热血复仇】全台首播，任职于顶尖会计事务所的黄东柱，实力超群，年纪轻轻就坐上组长的位子，在父亲坠海身亡以意外结案后，整理遗物的东柱发现，纪录大企业逃税的本子凭空消失了，他火速考上地方国税局。靠著揭发知名球星的逃税案，立马成为国税局的当红炸子鸡，本以为能离真相更近，却被调职到「国税厅5局」，这个被大家称作垃圾场的单位，而他又该如何率领团队深入调查，找到真正的杀父仇人呢?

programme.title: 妈妈要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任劳任怨大半辈子的慈母觉醒切割贪财不孝子】因丈夫早逝，独自抚养四名子女的尹正爱，就如同天下所有的妈妈一样，为了孩子总是愿意牺牲自己，一路从路边的菜贩打拼，多年后与大女儿允姬开了间点心餐厅。正当一切都看似幸福美满时，孩子们的婚姻、事业、学业纷纷出现状况，在面对问题时儿女们总持相反意见，并只贪图母亲的遗产，让正爱深感背叛，在朋友的劝说下，正爱打算不再以孩子为生活重心，并在缘分安排下开始了第二春。

programme.title: 依法相爱吧
programme.desc: 【李升基×李世荣二次合作，青梅竹马谱出律政罗曼史！！】改编自人气网路小说，「怪物天才检察官」金正浩与「韩国小姐出身律师」金琉璃，青梅竹马重逢后，一起经营「LawCafé」的故事。既是律师事务所、又是咖啡馆的小天地里，用温暖的饮品与犀利的法律智慧，帮助无数人伸张正义。从法庭到日常，辩论化为斗嘴，正义化为浪漫，疗愈又甜蜜的爱情由此展开。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道总裁《飞狐外传》林雨申恋上俏邻居《光芒》蔡文静！】吴忧因车祸意外放男友鸽子惨遭分手，而同样在这场车祸中丧命的是雅曼生物科技总裁何西亚的未婚妻陆芸。吴忧分手后寄情于工作，投入新职场认识了陆芸的妹妹陆蔓，成为了闺蜜。在公事上与何西亚有了合作，不打不相识的这对欢喜冤家，好不容易发展成为恋人,此时发现陆芸在他们之间串连起来的缘分…

programme.title: 步步惊心
programme.desc: 那一天，张晓的命运被一场车祸彻底改写。她眼看著那辆失控的卡车将自己的灵魂撞出了躯体，而她，既没有进医院也没有进天堂，却是被撞进了清朝的宫廷中。就像铺天盖地的穿越小说里写的那样，张晓的灵魂跨过时间的隧道，在一个叫马尔泰.若曦的十六岁清朝女孩的体内，重生了…时年，康熙第四十三。天下太平，但一场震动历史的「九龙夺嫡」正在暗潮涌动。权利的厮杀，爱情的灼烧，在被无限放大的历史舞台上，张晓，不，是马尔泰•若曦的命运无可避免的与众位亲王阿哥们交织在一起…她知道自己不该卷入这场九王夺嫡的争斗中，可心不由己，因为这里有她所爱的，也有爱著她的…若曦最后选择的究竟是温润如玉的八阿哥，还是面冷心热的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人?等历史的风云过后，可以陪她看夕阳西下、云卷云舒的又将是谁？

programme.desc: 【改编人气美国影集，张东健×朴炯植联手成为法律界黄金拍档！！】头脑聪明，拥有过目不忘天才能力的高延宇，却因家境关系却步成为律师。混进了律师事务所遇上韩国顶级资深律师崔江锡。随著事件发生与时间相处成为黄金拍档，崔江锡要如何亦师亦友的带著没有正式念过大学也只是菜鸟律师的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: Baby Einstein - Baby's First Sounds: Discoveries for Little Ears
programme.desc: Perhaps the sweetest sounds you'll ever hear are the babbles and coos that one day become ma-ma, da-da and I love you. Besides being music to your ears, these baby steps of language change everything as your little one discovers an exciting, powerful new way of relating to the world! Baby's First Sounds invites both of you to share these memorable moments: those precious ''firsts'' that come around once in your baby's lifetime.

programme.title: Timmy Time
programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.desc: Thomas has it all: family and career at its best. But when his company’s most lucrative deal ever is about to close, something goes terribly wrong. He is arrested for the murder of his business partner when his fingerprint is found on the murder weapon.

programme.title: Three Quarter Moon
programme.desc: Hartmut, a taxi-driver, is left in a bitter slump when his wife leaves him. That is, until he gets six-year-old Hayat and her mother in his taxi. In a serendipitous turn of events, Hayat is left under his care and she helps him learn to enjoy life again.

programme.title: Submission
programme.desc: Lúcia is raped by her husband and presses charges against him. In her quest for justice, she must battle her husband who is the son of the State's Vice Attorney, and the Portuguese legal system with its patriarchal beliefs.

programme.title: Wars
programme.desc: Following in her father’s footsteps, and yearning to fill the existential emptiness within her, 20-year-old Emma decides to join the army. In an environment of harsh discipline and repressive rules, Emma unexpectedly falls in love with her superior.

programme.title: Esteban
programme.desc: In Cuba, while helping his single mother sell black market beauty products, a 9-year-old boy dreams of becoming a pianist.

programme.title: Clean Sweep 1: Done Is Done
programme.desc: Shelly Mohan, a housewife and mother of three, makes an irreparable decision and commits a horrific act when Charlie Lynch, a man from her troubled past, contacts her.

programme.title: Clean Sweep 2: Post Mortem
programme.desc: Shelly's husband Jason, a Garda Detective, is delighted to be assigned to the case, with no sense where the trail may lead. While he and his co-worker, Fiona, focus on a sex worker, Shelly realizes she may have left evidence in the dead man's hotel room.

programme.title: Bad Investigate
programme.desc: A corrupt cop sets out to hunt down a dangerous drug dealer who is seeking revenge for the death of his brother. Also trying to catch the same criminal is an FBI agent.

programme.title: A Butterfly's Heart
programme.desc: Juozapas is a quiet boy who cultivates insects in an abandoned house. He has a big bulge under his weird sweater and the school’s tough kids call him “balloon”. Rugilè moves to town and becomes Juozapas’ friend. She is the first to discover his secret.

programme.title: Jeanny: The Fifth Girl
programme.desc: In a picturesque tiny town near Vienna, young girls have been vanishing without a trace for years. Jeanny has just fallen in love with a mysterious man. But when she notices signs of a dark side in him, she becomes suspicious. Will she be the next victim?

programme.title: A Mirror
programme.desc: When Naina's daughter goes missing after a night out, she sets out in pursuit to find her, with nightmarish fears which eventually lead her into another reality that she least expected.

programme.title: The Deep
programme.desc: March 1984, a few miles off the south coast of Iceland, a fishing boat sank with all its men. One of the crew members miraculously survived. After six hours in the ocean, the exhausted man is washed ashore, only to find himself on a deadly lava field.

programme.title: All My Friends Hate Me
programme.desc: Pete is cautiously excited about reuniting with his college crew for a birthday weekend. But, one by one, his friends slowly turn against him. Is he being punished, is he paranoid, or is he part of some sick joke?

programme.title: Karakol
programme.desc: After recently losing her father, Clara discovers a passport, foreign bills and letters while going through his things. Suspecting that he is living a secret life, she embarks on a trip to Karakil, a lake in Tajikistan, to find out the truth.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: The Master Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wong's disciples and frames him for robbery and murder. Wong has to fight against the culprit to prove his own innocence and take revenge for his disciples.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural "Bloody Parrot". Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: The Golden Lion is a bandit with good martial arts skills and often robs from the rich to help the poor. He is ambushed and attacked by a gang one night but luckily found help from a master healer, who has to find a way to treat him while they are both being chased by the gang.

programme.title: The Pure and the Evil
programme.desc: Two teen girls, Rose and May, become close friends despite their different social backgrounds. The rich girl May moves to America but returns years later to see Rose, now a beauty queen and bar girl. Rose is immediately attracted to Fang's fiance and their relationship quickly deteriorates when Rose sets out to pursue him...

programme.title: A Deadly Secret
programme.desc: A corrupt magistrate, obsessed with finding a hidden treasure, jails and tortures his daughter's lover and buries his daughter alive! Ironically, it is in her coffin that the secret to the hidden treasure is found, setting off a frenzy of destruction.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: At St. Morant Hospital, a harried but lovely administrator must deal with lusty interns, student nurses, a delirious surgeon, a dissection fiend, a criticizing Commissioner and gross negligence at regular intervals! This comedy is based on the hugely successful British Carry On! film series.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the men's help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his father's martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hung's passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lu's disciple.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again...

programme.title: The Imperial Swordsman
programme.desc: Fu is a government officer heading home after being charged with falsifying reports. En route, he encounters & recruits a skilled swordsman as a bodyguard. They then meet a fleeing bride and her maid who asked to join them for protection. When the group reach a ruined temple however, a gang of assassins appear and attack them...

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: The Savage Five
programme.desc: A group of bandits flees with a stolen safe to a village where they oppress the villagers and force the blacksmith Wei to unlock the safe. Wei refuses and flees to report to officials, while heroes of the town emerge to fight the bandits.

programme.title: Till the End of Time
programme.desc: This is Jenny Hu's stunning debut as a struggling singer who tries to keep her career and marriage intact. This movie also includes seven memorable hit songs.

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlong's younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles...

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why. Apparently a Yan killed her family 18 years ago and she only has vengeance on her mind...

programme.title: The Magnificent Concubine
programme.desc: Yang Gui Fei is the beloved concubine of Emperor Tang Ming Huang, who is so besotted with her that he leaves the running of the country to Prime Minister Yang Guo Zhong, the brother of Yang Gui Fei. The Prime Minister is corrupt and cruel to the army, causing them to revolt and endanger the throne. Yang Gui Fei is also implicated and kills herself.

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
programme.desc: In a great rendition of The Silver Fox and Legend of the Fox comes this exciting adventure, where the only thing between the clan leaders and certain death is Hui Ying-hung.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Swift Sword
programme.desc: A righteous swordsman, Bai Yi Pang, seeks revenge on an evil clan but is crippled after being beaten up by them. Years later, a young man encounters Bai who is hiding in a cave. Bai decides to teach this determined young man his Swift Sword skills so that he can help Bai take revenge on the evil clan.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brother's death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: Crocodile River
programme.desc: This story has a Romeo and Juliet flavour. Two families who hate each other live across the opposite sides of a river filled with crocodiles and do not bother to have a bridge built. Their respective children meet in university and fall in love, but have to find ways to be together and resolve the hatred between their families.

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by "Drunken Master", this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, which will prove hard to overcome...

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World
programme.desc: Yin Tian Chou's parents were killed over a pair of flame-shaped blades. He and his sister were rescued, raised, and trained separately by a hero and a villain, each inheriting one of the blades. Sworn enemies at first, they eventually uncover their true identities and join forces to avenge their parents' deaths.

programme.title: Fangs of the Cobra
programme.desc: Incredibly, the title serpent is not a harbinger of horror, but actually the film's hero. This virtuous viper sniffs out bombs, fights gangs, battles a baby-killing rodent and even takes on a duplicitous woman. This one-of-a-kind thriller will be applauded by reptile fans everywhere.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Mad Monk is up against the equally legendary scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin. The duo create havoc as they vie with each other, be it in mirth, magic, women or weapons!

programme.title: Ambitious Kung Fu Girl
programme.desc: Si Si, a spoiled and naive rich girl with only basic kung fu training, becomes enchanted by the legends of the fearless hero Qin Ge. Determined to escape her father's arranged marriage, she disguises herself as a man and sets out to find him, hoping to challenge Qin Ge-only to be drawn into a deadly plot within the criminal underworld.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth...

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiance so as to drive away two women whom he does not like...

programme.title: The Imperial Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: The story revolves around a maverick, a band of woman warriors and a group of ruthless bandits. The maverick teams up with the woman warriors to battle the bandits seeking to raid the emperor's tomb.

programme.title: Between Tears and Smiles
programme.desc: Fan Jia Shu is a kind-hearted student who is smitten with Shen, a heart-rending love song singer. However, he is not the only one who has eyes for Shen. The General's henchmen are also determined to present the songstress to their superior as a gift. Fan receives help from an unexpected person just in time to save the woman he loves.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks the society, forcing an inexperienced pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant. Their journey to deliver the infant to safety is filled with dangers that would require help from other allies...

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale...

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His master's daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.desc: An archaeologist Jack, and a scientist William, stumble upon ancient Qin Dynasty artifacts that lead them to the mausoleum and mysteriously connects Jack to his past life as a warrior in ancient China, starting their mythical journey.

programme.title: City of Desire
programme.desc: Sister 13 returns to Macau after 17 years to succeed her father's underground empire, the prostitution business. She tries to stop their exploitation of the sex workers, but Macau's economy flourished after the handover, propelling the prostitution and gambling businesses. The city is blinded by desire and Sister 13 can do nothing to help...

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip's boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim's sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist's drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Wing is an elite in the police force but has been drowning his guilt in booze after his entire team was killed by the "Gang of Five" in a mission. A year later, a young rookie detective with a complicated background is assigned to partner Wing and manages to inspire him into action, as Wing vows to take down the gang.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kong's brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Mr. Virgin is a romantic comedy about a twenty-nine year-old man Chao Yu-ting (Alfred Chang) who has seemingly been cursed. He becomes paranoid when a Feng Shui expert tells him it will be unlucky for him to marry before the age of thirty... so comical chaos line the days up to his next birthday!

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The famous "Gang Trio" is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million dollars. When they realize that the triad is after both the ransom and the baby's life, they decide to make the hostage their protege. Cornered by cops and threatened by gangsters, the three 'Rob-B-Hood' must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfather's fortune with one condition - he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, Fat is a gangster who suffers from amnesia. Believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters' best ally. To complicate matters further, a gangster named Wind, who looks exactly like Fat, starts a turf war with Big Bro.

programme.title: Everlasting Love
programme.desc: Young intern doctor Eric meets Pei Jun and quickly falls in love with her, unaware that she works as a hostess in a night club. Despite their social differences, can their love story defy the odds and lead to a happily ever after?

programme.title: Everlasting Love
programme.desc: Young intern doctor Eric meets Pei Jun and quickly falls in love with her, unaware that she works as a hostess in a night club. Despite their social differences, can their love story defy the odds and lead to a happily ever after?

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Long Arm of the Law Part 3
programme.desc: Chinese ex-soldier Li is wrongly accused and seeks refuge in Hong Kong to escape a death sentence. En route, he meets Sam and Moon. While Li has fallen in love with Moon, Hong Kong triad kidnaps Moon and coerces Li into aiding a robbery. Meanwhile, the mainland police officer tracks Li's path to Hong Kong, intensifying the chase.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife's debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Dummy Mommy, without a Baby
programme.desc: Fong Lai Kuen works at an advertising agency but is about to be sacked by her boss after offending him. She pretends to be pregnant so that the company cannot fire her, according to the labour law. Since then, Fong receives much care and love from her colleagues and begins to feel guilty about her lie as things develop out of her expectations.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: The Story of Woo Viet
programme.desc: Former Vietnamese veteran Woo Viet arrives a refugee camp in Hong Kong and meets his pen pal Quan. Subsequently, he encounters Shum Ching, with whom he attempts to flee to the US. However, the pair end up stranded in Manila's Chinatown, where at the hands of the local triads Woo becomes a hired killer, while Shum is forced into prostitution.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Ninth Happiness
programme.desc: A comedy starring many popular movie stars, this is a story about a magistrate and his brothers aiming to introduce sin and romance into the virtuous community of Rainbow Village. As they vie for the affections of a charming young village maiden, conflicts arise, adding a twist to their mischievous endeavours.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Wise Guys Never Die
programme.desc: Nick meets Teddy, a con artiste, when he is sent to prison for embezzlement, and Teddy teaches him all the gambling tricks. After their release, they team up with Teddy's lover Lora, to take revenge on Dragon, who framed Teddy for his sentence. Nick though is seduced by Lora and they end up in an affair. Will Nick finally join Teddy in his revenge?

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price...

programme.title: Midnight Fly
programme.desc: With her marriage in crisis, Michele takes off to Europe for a vacation and meets a Japanese woman named Miki. As they become friends and travel together, Michele discovers that Miki is her husband's mistress. When Miki goes missing in Morocco, Michele does everything she can to find her but ends up paying a heavy price...

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from To's father and bitter jealousy from her designated fiance, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: Young priest Hong disguises himself to protect Bai, a prostitute, while Detective Liu investigates her ties to a prostitution ring. Hong finds Bai a lawful job and helps her negotiate with the underworld. Meanwhile, Liu's investigation causes misunderstandings - can he crack down on the gang? How will Hong manage his emotions as Bai falls for him?

programme.title: To the Fore
programme.desc: The cycling team's top sprinter Zheng Zi Yuan teams up with two domestiques, Ming and Tian, who assist him to win the race. When Ming and Tian get tired of sacrificing their own chances to win, an accident causes the team to break up but the trio soon team up again for another race. Who will be the first to cross the line this time?

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Model from Hell
programme.desc: Anna, an exceptional student in a modelling school, becomes the target of envy from fellow models, who all die mysteriously when they want to harm her. It turns out that when Anna is upset, she undergoes a terrifying transformation and can wield lethal psychic power...

programme.title: Dream Lover
programme.desc: Ka Shing meets Kitty one day and they fall quickly in love. However, Kitty disappears shortly and when they meet years later, she is already married. To comfort himself, Ka Shing asks a mystic master to let Kitty appear in his dreams so that he can be with her constantly, even though she can only be his dream lover...

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: Man Wanted 3
programme.desc: Street kid Dong idolizes Mongkok triad leader Pu Jun and inadvertently joins his gang. When rival Xi Yang seizes control by illicit means, Pu Jun decides to take him down. At the same time, Pu Jun uncovers Dong as a police undercover and banishes him, but Dong sheds his undercover identity to join Pu Jun to seek revenge against Xi Yang.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.desc: Jims Trollhunting life and his high school life collide when Claire becomes a target for Goblin revenge.

programme.desc: Jim must surrender to Bular and unlock the Killahead Bridge to save kidnapped Blinky and promises Claire that he will get her brother back.

programme.desc: After a crowverine gliding mishap, Dawn loses her confidence and tells Eep she's taking a break from adventures. Eep convinces Dawn to join her on one last adventure - climbing Grrr Mountain.

programme.title: Dragons: Riders of Berk S1 - Defiant One
programme.desc: Hiccup and Snotlout struggle to find their way back from Outcast Island.

programme.title: Harvey Girls Forever! S2 - Hero Effect VR the World
programme.desc: Fredo's filming a second movie -- and starring in it, too. But his bloated ego's too much to bear. Richie builds a game powered by RichCoins.

programme.title: Dinotrux Supercharged S3 - Diamond Bit
programme.desc: When Ty gets tangled in a shockarachnid web Revvit ClickClack and a superstitious Otto must go on a highstakes adventure in the ruins of an ancient ravine to find a legendary diamond bit

programme.title: The Adventures Of Rocky And Bullwinkle S1 - Almost Famoose: Chapter Four
programme.desc: Rocky and Bullwinkle return to Frostbite Falls to discover that because they failed to rebuild the giant birdbath, their beloved town is now completely overrun with dirty, zombie-like birds.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can I Cheer Up Kevin?
programme.desc: JESS, and his friends are looking after Kevin the carp while Horace goes to visit a friend. They decide to clean out HORACE'S pond for him and take all the yukky pond weed to the river where the hungry fishes gobble it up. But when they get back they find that KEVIN is unhappy in his pond. "How can I cheer up Kevin?" That's the Big Question. First JESS thinks that KEVIN might be lonely so they take it in turns to keep him company. But KEVIN seems even more unhappy than before.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can We Decorate The Christmas Tree?
programme.desc: It's Christmas Eve on Greendale Farm. Jess is very very excited. Every year Mimi decorates the special tree in the woods and the friends all gather around to sing and play and open presents. But when Jess, Mimi and Willow arrive to leave presents at the tree they're shocked to see that the wind has blown all the decorations away! How dreadful! - How will they celebrate Christmas with no decorations? And Mimi can't help as she and Willow have promised to deliver presents outside the farm.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can I Make The Trolley Go Faster?
programme.desc: Jess and his friends are playing a game trying to use wind power to push the trolley through the hay bale arch. None of them can blow hard enough so it always slows down before it gets to the arch. Jess asks the Big Question - how can I make the trolley go faster. They try different ideas - blowing, making a bigger wind by blowing as a group, making an even bigger wind by flapping potato sacks but nothing is strong enough.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can We Mend Baa's Trough?
programme.desc: There's a hole in the bottom of Baa's trough so none of the thirsty friends can have a drink. How can we mend the trough, wonders Jess. Hey, that's the Big Question. Jess decides to ask Horace for help but Horace has a problem of his own. He's trying to make a lovely new musical sound but the square shaped piece of bark he's got doesn't make a very good noise when he clangs it with a stick. Jess borrows the bark to cover the hole in the trough but it's the wrong shape.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - What's That Green Hairy Stuff?
programme.desc: Jess and the puppies find some strange green hairy stuff growing under the water barrel. The puppies are scared of it and Jess promises them that he'll find out what it is at once. Hey, that's the big question! Jess thinks the green hairy stuff might be grass. He goes to ask Baa, who's a grass expert. Baa, Billie and Jess compare the green hairy stuff and ordinary grass using Billie's magnifying glass. It isn't grass but it is a plant.

programme.title: Guess with Jess S1 - How Can I Find My Friends?
programme.desc: Jess's friends have planned a special surprise but he can't find any of them to find out what it is! How can he find his friends? Hey, that's the Big Question! He finds a trail of Willow's hoof prints but they stop at a puddle. Then they follow a trail of wool from Baa but that stops too. They find a walking haystack but it turns out to be Mimi. Jess is baffled.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Bands On The Run Vote For Casper
programme.desc: Bands on the Run Casper and Jimmy form a rock band to compete in the Deedstown Battle of the Bands. Vote for Casper Mantha is angling to win the office of Class Rep, but Kibosh fancies having a fellow ghost in power.

programme.title: Casper's Scare School S1 - Permission ImpossibleWhat Possessed You
programme.desc: Permission Impossible When Ra's parents refuse to let him go on the school camping trip, he sneaks away and gets lost in the Scary Woods with Casper and Mantha. What Possessed You? When a lesson in taking possession of a human body goes awry, Casper's human ends up taking possession of him!

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - The Nest
programme.desc: When the Rescue Riders save Viking chief Duggard, they’re invited to visit his village of Huttsgalor, where they must prove they're kind and helpful.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Deep Trouble
programme.desc: Dak's lack of planning gets him, Cutter and Winger lost with Elbone in the Maze Caves, and Leyla's overthinking threatens the effort to rescue them.

programme.title: Home: Adventures With Tip And Oh! S1 - Little Kisses Snow Day
programme.desc: Tip busts Oh eating kitty litter and says he'll never get kissed by My Mom again.Oh and Tip help out all his friends when they freeze into Boovsicles.

programme.desc: Sick of nighttime cutting fun short, the kids pulls an all-nighter. A mystery critter shows up on Harvey Street and Dot wants it gone!

programme.title: Happy Ever After - EP8
programme.desc: TUNG KOON (AU YEUNG CHUN WAH, BOBBY) born with a special ‘King’s Tongue’ is betrayed by his assistant, SIU SIU (CHAN MIU YING, MARIANE) who had prepared some chili source without permission. TUNG is accused of deceiving the Emperor and is forced to flee from Guangzhou to the capital. When SIU discovered that someone had used her to trap TUNG, she sees TUNG in person and apologizes. TUNG and SIU eventually reconcile. Love feeling blossoms between them.

programme.title: L'Escargot - EP17
programme.desc: Renovation contractor KWAN KA-ON (Miu Kiu Wai) is the elder of four siblings, while his wife SZE LONG-KIU (Sonija Kwok) is a typical housewife. Buying a house is their longtime dream. But when his eldest brother, KWAN KA-HONG’s business goes under, they shelve their plan to help him overcome his difficulties. KIU has to look for a job too.

programme.title: A Perfect Man - EP8
programme.desc: Yeung Yat-cheng (Joe Ma) has a good reputation in the realm of personal security. He is invited by his buddy Ha Chung-chau (Tsui Wing) to join a security company that is tasked with protecting a tycoon called Tseung Ding-tin (KK Cheung). While starting his new job, Yat-cheung is faced with personnel issues. Meanwhile, due to his unhappy childhood, Yat-cheng does not believe in marriage. However, he happens to hook up with Yau Chi-ching (Ali Lee).

programme.title: A STEP INTO THE PAST - EP14
programme.desc: HONG SHIU LUNG (KOO TIN LOK, LOUIS) is an secret agent in the 21st Century. He joins a pilot programme to fly back in time hoping that he will salvage his unforgettable love. However, something goes wrong during the mission. He is sent back to the Warring States Period. Emperor QI (LAM RAYMOND) has not been crowned yet and is kept hostage in Chiu. In order to return to the future, LUNG decides to help QI become emperor. With his wisdom and Kungfu, he is recognized and given important tasks.

programme.title: The Exorcist's 2nd Meter - EP23
programme.desc: Taxi driver Ma Kwai (Kenneth Ma) goes down the road to exorcism as he is destined to perpetuate the legacy of genie Shek Kam-dong. He is also reunited with the mature soul of his buddy Mok Wai-ho (Hubert Wu). He even encounters Sze Loi-sze (Gloria Tang) and his younger brother Sze Lo-sze, who are both exorcists. However, some demonic curse has caused Ma Kwai to keep thinking of a doctor by the name of Chong Tsz-yeuk (Mandy Wong).
